chapters.title: Chapter 3930: A Duke! I
paragraphs: The atmosphere was heavy!
The assembled Living Existences were staring at Noah with expressions that ranged from controlled anger to calculated assessment.
His words were tyrannically heavy, forcing beings of immense power to confront their own hypocrisy!
Then, cutting through the charged atmosphere with absolute finality, came a single word.
"Disperse."
HUUM!
The command resonated with such overwhelming authority that Existence itself seemed to shiver in response.
Many present instantly recognized the voice as belonging to a terrifyingly powerful Honored Living Existence, but this time the source felt different.
It was not descending from the skies, but immediate and present.
Something already here.
They had never even sensed his approach!
Through the rapidly forming corridor of retreating figures strode a being whose very presence altered the fundamental nature of the space around him.

He was fully adorned in sleek silver armor that appeared forged from liquid starlight, each plate perfectly fitted while emanating waves of Living Spiritual Authority so pure they made the surrounding air shimmer.

His head was entirely covered by the same silver plating, shaped into the magnificent form of a bull. The craftsmanship was unfathomable, each curve designed to project both terrifying majesty and absolute regality!
In his hands, he carried a radiant cylindrical staff that pulsed with inner light.
All Living Existences quieted and began dispersing according to his command, their eyes reflecting shock.
A few among them clearly understood that an Honored Living Existence of this particular bearing was someone connected to...Royalty.
To the Royal Living Existences!
The armored figure’s attention settled upon Noah and Sigrid, but there was something peculiar in his focus.
He seemed to be entirely ignoring Sigrid, his gaze fixed upon Noah as if he were the only being present who truly mattered.
|Your Sponsor has requested you.|
The words entered their ears freely.
The bull-headed figure then tapped his cylindrical staff against the golden pathway, and existential light erupted around them.
The illumination wrapped around Noah first, then seemed to remember Sigrid as an afterthought, the light extending to encompass her a full second later.
As if she had been forgotten. As if she were nobody compared to Noah.
They disappeared in a flash of radiance that left afterimages burned into the observers!
The surroundings fell into immediate hush as the assembled Living Existences looked at each other. Silent communications began flowing between them.
Who the hell was that Fold Dweller?
"Find out everything you can on him," came whispered instructions. "Keep tabs, but be careful since a Royal Living Existence is involved! Likely a Royal Living Spirit!"
The commands spread through the crowd, each being understanding they had witnessed something that would require careful investigation!
The image of...Noah Osmont was burned into their minds like a brand!
Across Concordia.
In its deeper corners!
There was...a tower among many towers.

The crystalline golden tower that served as their destination appeared unremarkable from the outside, its architecture following the same principles that governed most structures throughout Aeternitas Concordia.
But appearances were often carefully constructed lies in a place where power danced in patterns too complex for most minds to follow.
WAP!
Noah and Sigrid materialized within a white-gold hall whose dimensions seemed to shift.
The space was simultaneously vast and intimate, its walls stretching toward infinity while maintaining the atmosphere of a private meeting chamber.

The Honored Living Existence who had transported them stood beside them before beginning to walk toward the far end of the hall. There, rising from the polished floor, stood white steps that led to an elevated throne.
But it was not the throne itself that captured Noah’s attention.
It was the figures arrayed along those steps like living statues carved from pure authority.

Three Honored Living Existences stood on one side, while two occupied the other, their combined presence creating an atmosphere so dense with power that lesser beings would have been crushed by proximity alone.
Their escort moved to join the group of two, bringing the total to six Honored Living Existences serving as guards for whoever commanded such protection!
The woman seated upon the white throne was glorious to look at. Her stellar dark hair seemed to contain Wheels within its depths.
Her tan skin radiated warmth that spoke to utmost glory!
Terrifying waves of Living Origin Authority cascaded over her skin like liquid starlight. But it was her eyes that truly captured Noah’s attention.
They resembled dozens of stacked Wheels of Existence, each one rotating at different speeds and containing the compressed essence of entire weavings of existence!
The moment Noah and Sigrid materialized within the hall, those impossible eyes focused upon them.
WAP!
In an instant that defied perception, the woman flashed from her throne to appear directly in front of Sigrid, her movement so swift that even Noah’s enhanced senses could barely track it.
But he did nothing as he did not sense danger!
She embraced Sigrid with desperate intensity, her arms wrapping around the younger woman with tenderness that seemed...off given the overwhelming power she radiated.
"I am sorry." she whispered with heavy emotion, her voice carrying genuine regret. "I did not agree with them... I am sorry!"
The repetition carried the weight of someone who had been carrying guilt for a long time.
This terrifying entity was actually apologizing!
But Sigrid’s response was delivered with coldness.
"Let go of me, O Duke Gwendolyn," she said with calm authority.
BOOM!
Duke.
A fucking Duke!
One of the eighty-one Dukes of the Living Origins. Beings whose collective authority governed the fate of countless Wheels of Existence!

Noah’s eyes flashed with sharp focus. When he attempted to examine Duke Gwendolyn, he encountered barriers his abilities could not penetrate. Her weavings of existence operated on an entirely different level, so refined that even identifying her name was beyond his current capabilities!

He could observe the work of his Refined Early Living Existential Glyph of Loot as it drew bubbles of authority from the six Honored Living Existences, their power flowing toward him in quantities too small for them to notice. But from Duke Gwendolyn herself... nothing.
Her existence was closed off entirely, protected by barriers even a Refined Glyph could not penetrate.
Hearing Sigrid’s cold words, Duke Gwendolyn sighed.
She released her embrace slowly, holding Sigrid’s shoulders for a moment before letting go and reappearing upon her throne with the same impossible swiftness.
Her expression returned to one of utmost regality and calmness, the brief crack in her composure sealed behind layers of authority as she focused her attention upon Noah.

She looked him up and down as if gauging everything about his nature, his potential, his worthiness to stand in her presence. Her eyes became somber at a certain point in this examination, as if she had discovered something that both impressed and concerned her.
When she spoke, her voice carried the weight of absolute authority.

"You are an unexpected variable in all of this, and you seem to be unfathomably profound. I was planning many things to not draw attention to the Young Miss here, and there was an intervention early at the Coalition Gateway that I am still tracking down the one responsible, but you... were exceptional enough just now that nobody even gazed at the terrifying wonder standing beside you. For that, you have my thanks."
A Duke of the Living Origins had just expressed gratitude to a Fold Dweller from Paradoxical Folds.
But Noah’s gaze remained calm even while facing such a terrifying being!
He simply nodded as he spoke out.

"Of course. After being labeled Paradoxical and drawing attention, I knew I needed to do something to take the eyes off Sigrid. So I put the spotlight on myself. Used a treasure even Living Existences cannot ignore. Everyone will focus on me and ignore the prize right beside me. I saw all of this and planned for it so...no need for the thanks!"
WAA!

Duke Gwendolyn’s eyes widened slightly, her gaze focusing on Noah with renewed intensity as she began to understand that this unexpected variable might be even more significant than she had initially calculated!

chapters.title: Chapter 3931: A Duke! II
paragraphs: After Noah’s tyrannical words, the Duke and six Honored Living Existences regarded him with expressions of cold calmness.
The temperature in the hall seemed to drop several degrees as their collective displeasure made itself known through subtle fluctuations in the ambient authority that permeated every surface.
In the silence that followed, Sigrid began to stroll around the hall with unhurried grace, her movements carrying the fluid confidence of someone entirely comfortable here!
She approached an arched window veiled with Living Existential Authority, its surface opaque to outside observers while remaining transparent to those within.
Through this one-way barrier, she could gaze out into the sprawling magnificence of Concordia without revealing her presence to the countless beings moving through its golden pathways.
"I do not plan to return to the Heart of Origin," she said with the calm finality of THE Living Order making a decision that had been long considered and carefully weighed.
The Heart of Origin.

It was a place countless weavings of distance away from their current location, nestled in the very heart of the Transcendent Origin Folds where the Royal Living Origins and the Council of Living Origin resided in splendor that defied description.
It was the seat of power for their entire hierarchy, the place where decisions were made that affected the fate of infinite weavings of Existence!
"I will not return," Sigrid continued, her voice steady as it could be.

"For the sake of fully returning to my power, and to awaken Order, I plan to go across the Battlefront Folds and experience Existence truly. I feel that if I go through existence and impose my own Order in regions of chaos, this will act like infusing blood into my Heart of Order."
Duke Gwendolyn’s expression shifted to one of deep concern as she processed these words.
"I heard Altheon mention this, but... it is dangerous. You are far too important. A single Inevitability that you cannot see, sense, or handle, and you would be dead."
The weight of that possibility buzzed.
The silence that followed was heavy!
It was at this moment that Noah moved with deliberate purpose, walking across the hall to stand behind Sigrid before openly taking her hand in his.
The action was simple, intimate, and absolutely tyrannical in its implications!
The Honored Living Existences immediately buzzed with Authority, their forms radiating displeasure at this display of familiarity between him and their precious Young Miss!
Duke Gwendolyn’s frown deepened as she observed the casual way Noah intertwined his fingers with Sigrid’s.

Noah held Sigrid’s hand as if examining its structure, his attention apparently focused on some detail that only he could perceive. When he looked up to meet Duke Gwendolyn’s gaze, his expression carried the calm gaze of a ruler that had gone through too much!
"Do you know...what Order is?" he asked with the calm precision.
Duke Gwendolyn’s response was delivered with stern authority. "Why don’t you enlighten us? I saw that you were a talker out there..."
Noah smiled and continued.

"Order is not the mere absence of chaos, nor is it the rigid imposition of arbitrary rules upon unwilling subjects. True Order is the recognition of natural hierarchies, the understanding that some beings are meant to lead while others are destined to follow. It is the wisdom to see patterns where others see randomness, to find purpose where others find confusion."
His gaze swept across the assembled Honored Living Existences before returning to fix upon Duke Gwendolyn with laser intensity.

"If Order herself, THE Living Order, tells you that she must go through existence and experience the chaos so that she can correct it, then perhaps the appropriate response is not to question her judgment but to listen with the respect her nature demands. She understands her own requirements better than any external observer ever could."
HUUM!
The weight of his words seemed to press down upon everyone present!
Heavy silence followed his declaration, broken only when Duke Gwendolyn looked between him and Sigrid with an expression that had grown profoundly serious.
"Things are not how they used to be," she said, her voice taking on the sharp cadence of someone delivering unwelcome news.

"As always, everything revolves around Paradox. Paradox has always been powerful, dangerous, unpredictable. But...just minutes ago, Paradoxical Weavings did something that reminded us all exactly why the Loom is surrounded by Paradoxical energies in the first place."
Noah and Sigrid listened with calm attention as Duke Gwendolyn continued.

"There is a place where Living Existences jointly exist within the Transcendent Temporal Folds. A unique environment called the Nexus of Living Convergence, surrounded by such chaotic temporal weavings that a cloud of Paradox appeared around it naturally over the years. In that place, for eons, the Coalition of Living Existences kept a treasure. A Treasure that had made us unfathomably powerful over the years, with only thr topmost Living Existences knowing about it!"
Her expression grew darker as she recalled the details.

"Because that place was fortified like the environment around the Loom, it had Paradoxical weavings all around it. Any Paradoxes who approached would cause Inevitabilities to bloom, preventing any progress. They would be attacked by the very forces their nature summoned, and we would detect their presence and join the assault. For countless eons, Paradoxes never made their way inside. Until... today!"
BOOM!
Noah listened with careful attention, though internally he felt a flash of surprise. Had the Paradoxes moved so quickly?
Duke Gwendolyn’s voice took on the urgent quality of majesty.

"In the last hour, that place was compromised. Suddenly, groups of Honored Living Paradoxes and Royal Living Paradoxes led a surprise assault where somehow, they passed through the weavings of Paradox without producing Inevitabilities!"
WAA!
The implications of that statement were staggering.

"It took all Honored Living Existences and Royal Living Existences there by surprise, and there were heavy casualties. The Living Paradoxes took away the treasure that had been protected there for eons. A treasure that has made the Coalition of Living Existences... unfathomably powerful!"
Noah remained silent as Sigrid asked with cold curiosity. "What was the treasure being protected there?"
Duke Gwendolyn’s reply came with the weight of existential significance: "A Corpse!"
Noah’s eyes became sharp as understanding began to dawn. Internally, he felt a deeper chill as he asked: "Whose corpse exactly?"
Duke Gwendolyn looked at him silently for a long moment, as if weighing whether to reveal information that could reshape their understanding of everything.
Finally, she spoke with quiet finality.
"The Corpse...of an Early Creature!"
Oh.
Oh!!!

chapters.title: Chapter 3932: Power Must Be Taken! I
paragraphs: The corpse of an Early Creature!
The moment Duke Gwendolyn spoke those words, the entire hall became eerily silent.
A hush that seemed to press against the walls themselves, as if Existence was holding its breath!
Everybody was silent. The six Honored Living Existences stood like statues carved from concentrated authority, their forms radiating power yet somehow diminished by the weight of this revelation.
Noah’s eyes buzzed with countless complex thoughts as he turned to look through the veiled window toward distant Concordia.

The golden pathways and crystalline towers that had seemed so magnificent moments before now appeared somehow smaller, less significant when measured against the implications of what he had just learned.
His mind moved with the swift precision of someone calculating variables that could determine the fate of existence itself.
The Living Existences had possessed the corpse of an Early Creature for eons. The questions that arose from this single fact alone were heavy.
How had this corpse come to be? How had one of his kind died? Where were the others who should have prevented such a catastrophe?
The very concept of a dead Early Creature seemed to violate fundamental laws of Existence, yet here was evidence that such an impossibility had occurred.
At this moment of profound contemplation, Duke Gwendolyn continued.

"Altheon brought us news of the Paradox that does not produce Inevitabilities. The one known as both Ozymandias...and Aetheron. We did not get the chance to eliminate this being, and now it is as if his capability has been shared with the most powerful Living Paradoxes."
Her voice carried the weight of someone delivering a report from a war that was already lost.

"In the lead of the assault was someone we know to be called Honored Diviticus in our records, with her authority parting the dense concentrations of Paradox and preventing the rise of Inevitabilities while she allowed other Paradoxes to move freely through what should have been an impenetrable barrier!"

"The already powerful Living Paradoxes had gained something fundamental when they acquired the essence of the Paradox that produces no Inevitabilities, and now with the Corpse of an Early Creature, who knows what tremendous power they will wield. The Coalition of Living Existences needs THE Living Order as another weapon in their arsenal."
HUUM!
Another weapon in their arsenal.
The Living Existences still possessed depths of power that remained hidden, terrifying mysteries that could reshape the fundamental nature of existence.
Yet even they recognized the need for more weapons in the coming conflict.

Another silence descended upon the hall, heavier than the first. Noah continued to reflect on how events had unfolded, the chain of causation that led back to his own actions with uncomfortable clarity.
Because of him, a terrifying progression of events seemed to be accelerating beyond anyone’s ability to control.
He had inadvertently given Living Paradoxes wings. They were now more powerful than ever, all because Diviticus had obtained half a drop of his blood. Half a drop!
The magnitude of power contained in such an infinitesimal amount of his essence was both humbling and terrifying.
As he contemplated this reality, his mind flashed with possibilities. If half a drop could grant such capabilities to Living Existences...
Duke Gwendolyn observed Sigrid’s expression during this revelation, noting that the same determination remained etched across her features even after learning of these catastrophic developments.
She sighed with the weight of someone accepting an inevitable outcome.

"If you still wish to proceed even after knowing all this, then your safety will be paramount. If you are to move anywhere, you must have protection. Someone moving closely with you who will also help you understand how to best weave your existence. If you wish to move freely, I will have to form a team around you to traverse the Doorways of the Loom!"
Toward this proposal, Sigrid showed no complaints, her expression remaining steady as she contemplated the paths that lay ahead.
Noah continued gazing toward Aeternitas Concordia, his mind thinking about countless variables while simultaneously paying attention to developments of his existence elsewhere entirely!
Elsewhere.
On his Early Veiled Shore, Noah’s main body experienced utmost peace and serenity while sitting upon the golden sands that pulsed with glory.
The crystalline waters lapped gently at the shoreline, their sound creating a symphony of tranquility that spoke to forces older than Living Existences.
But this peace was interrupted by a goat currently staring at him from mere inches away from his face.
A goat!
Heidrun’s vibrant eyes blazed with fiery intensity as she gazed at him with an expression that clearly communicated her expectations.
She was looking as if saying.... Well? Where are the delicacies?!
Noah smiled at her imperious demand and produced the miniature wheel that the Living Elemental had used to compress his entire garden.
The compressed space contained the precious cargo that had drawn Heidrun’s attention across impossible distances.
The Auric Vitae Grass!
Noah gazed at the green-gold vegetation within the miniature construct, each blade shimmering with potential.

"I could give this to you to eat all of it, and then we would have to go through the trouble of looking for something like it again. How about planting it here so that you can have an endless supply?"
WAA!
Heidrun’s eyes pulsed with approval as the goat nodded her head with the regal satisfaction of someone whose wisdom had been properly acknowledged.
|Heidrun tremendously approves of this idea and knows the perfect plot for the Auric Vitae Grass.|
Her head whipped around across the Early Veiled Shore, the Budding Shore, as if she were inspecting what would be the perfect location for something like this!

|To plant something and grow it in the Early Veiled Shore, especially something as unique as the Auric Vitae Grass stemming from Doorways of the Loom, something critical is required to allow its anchor and eventual growth.|

sentences.text: The corpse of an Early Creature!
The moment Duke Gwendolyn spoke those words, the entire hall became eerily silent.
A hush that seemed to press against the walls themselves, as if Existence was holding its breath!
Everybody was silent.
The six Honored Living Existences stood like statues carved from concentrated authority, their forms radiating power yet somehow diminished by the weight of this revelation.
Noah’s eyes buzzed with countless complex thoughts as he turned to look through the veiled window toward distant Concordia.

The golden pathways and crystalline towers that had seemed so magnificent moments before now appeared somehow smaller, less significant when measured against the implications of what he had just learned.
His mind moved with the swift precision of someone calculating variables that could determine the fate of existence itself.
The Living Existences had possessed the corpse of an Early Creature for eons.
The questions that arose from this single fact alone were heavy.
How had this corpse come to be?
How had one of his kind died?
Where were the others who should have prevented such a catastrophe?
The very concept of a dead Early Creature seemed to violate fundamental laws of Existence, yet here was evidence that such an impossibility had occurred.
At this moment of profound contemplation, Duke Gwendolyn continued.
"Altheon brought us news of the Paradox that does not produce Inevitabilities.
The one known as both Ozymandias...and Aetheron.
We did not get the chance to eliminate this being, and now it is as if his capability has been shared with the most powerful Living Paradoxes."
Her voice carried the weight of someone delivering a report from a war that was already lost.

"In the lead of the assault was someone we know to be called Honored Diviticus in our records, with her authority parting the dense concentrations of Paradox and preventing the rise of Inevitabilities while she allowed other Paradoxes to move freely through what should have been an impenetrable barrier!"

"The already powerful Living Paradoxes had gained something fundamental when they acquired the essence of the Paradox that produces no Inevitabilities, and now with the Corpse of an Early Creature, who knows what tremendous power they will wield.
The Coalition of Living Existences needs THE Living Order as another weapon in their arsenal."
HUUM!
Another weapon in their arsenal.
The Living Existences still possessed depths of power that remained hidden, terrifying mysteries that could reshape the fundamental nature of existence.
Yet even they recognized the need for more weapons in the coming conflict.
Another silence descended upon the hall, heavier than the first.
Noah continued to reflect on how events had unfolded, the chain of causation that led back to his own actions with uncomfortable clarity.
Because of him, a terrifying progression of events seemed to be accelerating beyond anyone’s ability to control.
He had inadvertently given Living Paradoxes wings.
They were now more powerful than ever, all because Diviticus had obtained half a drop of his blood.
Half a drop!
The magnitude of power contained in such an infinitesimal amount of his essence was both humbling and terrifying.
As he contemplated this reality, his mind flashed with possibilities.
If half a drop could grant such capabilities to Living Existences...
Duke Gwendolyn observed Sigrid’s expression during this revelation, noting that the same determination remained etched across her features even after learning of these catastrophic developments.
She sighed with the weight of someone accepting an inevitable outcome.
"If you still wish to proceed even after knowing all this, then your safety will be paramount.
If you are to move anywhere, you must have protection.
Someone moving closely with you who will also help you understand how to best weave your existence.
If you wish to move freely, I will have to form a team around you to traverse the Doorways of the Loom!"
Toward this proposal, Sigrid showed no complaints, her expression remaining steady as she contemplated the paths that lay ahead.
Noah continued gazing toward Aeternitas Concordia, his mind thinking about countless variables while simultaneously paying attention to developments of his existence elsewhere entirely!
Elsewhere.
On his Early Veiled Shore, Noah’s main body experienced utmost peace and serenity while sitting upon the golden sands that pulsed with glory.
The crystalline waters lapped gently at the shoreline, their sound creating a symphony of tranquility that spoke to forces older than Living Existences.
But this peace was interrupted by a goat currently staring at him from mere inches away from his face.
A goat!
Heidrun’s vibrant eyes blazed with fiery intensity as she gazed at him with an expression that clearly communicated her expectations.
She was looking as if saying....
Well?
Where are the delicacies?!
Noah smiled at her imperious demand and produced the miniature wheel that the Living Elemental had used to compress his entire garden.

The Auric Vitae Grass!

chapters.title: Chapter 3933: Power Must Be Taken! II
paragraphs: The next prompt contained requirements that made even Noah shake his head at the level of difficulty associated with maintaining an Early Veiled Shore.

|A vital catalyst to allow for the anchor and growth of the Auric Vitae Grass is the Blood of an Early Creature. For the amount of Auric Vitae Grass on hand, approximately 18 Drops of Blood would be required.|
Noah read these prompts with the resignation!
But the benefits provided by the Early Veiled Shore were far too critical to abandon over concerns about cost- costs which werent truly costs as he could recover them in a short period of time!
So he went ahead.
"Let us proceed with the planting of the Auric Vitae Grass," he voiced aloud, his words carrying the weight of Existential command.
What occurred next was a scene of such primal beauty that it seemed to belong to the earliest epochs of existence itself.
The palm of his right hand opened like a flower blooming in reverse, and eighteen drops of dull crimson-gold blood flowed forth with the stately grace of liquid starlight.
Each drop pulsed with its own inner radiance, containing within its molecular structure the compressed essence of what it truly meant to be an Early Creature.

These drops moved through the air with purposeful intent, flowing toward an empty area close to the crystalline waters of the Shore but positioned further inland where the golden sands met the roots of the ancient trees. They arranged themselves into a perfect square formation before sinking into the ground with the weight of Existence being fulfilled.
The moment his blood touched the earth, transformation began.
The golden sands of that region shifted and changed, their very nature being rewritten by the influence of Early Creature essence.
A glorious plot of fertile land rose from the Shore itself, its surface shining with white and gold radiance that spoke to potential beyond normal understanding.
HUUM!
The soil seemed ready to nurture wonders that existed beyond the comprehension of lesser realms!
New prompts appeared before Noah, detailing the process.

|The Auric Vitae Grass must be planted in bundles of nine, with each bundle representing a complete cycle of growth and renewal. This work must be done physically by the Early Creature or a single helper stemming from the Early Veiled Shore, as the direct contact between your essence and the grass is required for proper integration with the Shore’s unique environment.|

Noah accepted these requirements with calm understanding. He expanded the miniature wheel to its full size, revealing the vibrant green-gold grass exactly as it had appeared in the garden surrounding the Living Elemental in Concordia.
The sight of it made the air itself seem to thicken with concentrated possibility.
The process that followed carried the weight of ritual he never expected to be doing!
Noah took his first bundle of nine grass shoots and approached the transformed plot with movements that seemed to echo ancient ceremonies.
As he began to plant, the Early Living Existential Glyphs across his body began to shine with soft radiance, their light casting patterns across the waters Shore.
His bare upper body glistened with Existential perspiration that caught and reflected the light of the Glyphs, creating an image of primal beauty as he worked the fertile soil with his hands.
Each movement was deliberate, precise, carrying the weight of someone performing sacred work that would echo across existence.
As he planted the first bundle, his consciousness filled with new information.

|The Early Sacred Living Farming Tower of Osmont has fully formed due to the unique circumstances of this planting. Your connection to the agricultural mysteries of Early Creatures has deepened beyond normal parameters.|
His hands suddenly became filled with verdant crystalline waves of light that pulsed in harmony with the planted grass!
The radiance spread from his fingers into the soil, creating connections between his essence and the growing vegetation that transcended normal botanical understanding.
Another prompt followed immediately!

|The growth and cultivation of all Early Sacred Herbs will now be five times faster than normal rates. The Early Veiled Shore has been recognized as a true agricultural home worthy of Early Creature cultivation.|
It was a glorious scene!
As Noah continued his sacred work, Heidrun approached with an expression of determination that transcended her usual arrogance.
She carefully took nine bundles of the precious grass in her mouth, exercising tremendous self-control to avoid consuming the delicacy she so craved.
Her movements carried the dignity of someone participating in a ceremony whose importance she fully understood.
Together, they worked in harmony that spoke to the deepest connections between Early Creatures and the Land Lifeforms who had chosen to serve them.
Noah’s hands moved with practiced precision while Heidrun positioned her bundles with careful attention to spacing and depth.
It was a glorious scene that seemed to capture the very essence of what the Early Veiled Shore was meant to represent!

An Early Creature and an Eminent Early Living Land Lifeform working together in harmony while around them, Moiraine and others maintained meditative positions or slept peacefully as their complexity continued to rise through exposure to the Shore’s concentrated authority!
The entire weaving of existence carried an air of primitive and magisterial authenticity that mocked the elaborate constructions and schemes of the Living Existences.

Here was power in its purest form, not wielded through elaborate hierarchies or complex machinations, but expressed through the simple act of nurturing growth in soil that had been blessed by the blood of an Early Creature.
As they worked, the Shore itself seemed to pulse with approval, its weavings pulsing with their movements in a symphony of cultivation!

The process of planting continued with the measured rhythm of sacred ritual, each bundle of nine Auric Vitae Grass shoots finding its place in the transformed soil with precision that spoke to ancient agricultural wonders!
Noah moved with unhurried grace, his hands working the blessed earth while Heidrun contributed her own careful plantings, the goat’s usual arrogance tempered by the solemnity of their shared task!

chapters.title: Chapter 3934: Power Must Be Taken! III
paragraphs: When the final bundle had been placed and the last of the golden soil patted into place around tender shoots, Noah and Heidrun stood at the edges of their green-gold plot with expressions of peace and contentment.
The work had been satisfying in ways that transcended normal accomplishment, connecting them to weavings that predated the concept of existence itself.
It felt unfathomably and magisterially peaceful in a way that could not be fully described!
Heidrun’s excitement was palpable as she gazed upon their handiwork, her crystalline eyes reflecting satisfaction that went beyond mere anticipation of future meals.
This was farming in its purest form, the nurturing of something that would provide sustenance and wonder for ages to come!
She could the see the future, and it was filled with glorious green gold grass!
And as if responding to their completion of this sacred work, new information began flowing across Noah’s mind.

|Auric Vitae Grass Growth Cycle- Complete maturity achieved in 1 hour from initial planting. Current planted specimens are already at 95% maturity due to the enhanced conditions of the Early Veiled Shore and the direct involvement of Early Creature essence in the cultivation process.|

|The Optimal harvest window begins at full maturity and extends for 24 hours before gradual decline in potency. During harvest, Seeds of the Auric Vitae Grass will naturally generate within the root systems and can be replanted immediately for continuous cultivation cycles.|

|Each harvested plot will yield triple the originally planted amount due to the Early Veiled Shore enhancement effects. Recommended replanting ratio: One-third seeds for expansion, two-thirds for immediate cultivation of new plots. This process allows for exponential growth of cultivated area over time.|

|The Early Sacred Living Farming Tower of Osmont provides passive growth acceleration. With proper timing and resource allocation, the Shore can support unlimited expansion of agricultural operations while maintaining optimal yield rates across all cultivated plots.|
HUUM!
Noah breathed in the sweet scent of growing grass as gentle winds carried the aroma across the Shore.
The shoots swayed with hypnotic rhythm, their movement synchronized to Glyphs that seemed to echo the heartbeat of existence itself!

He reached out to stroke Heidrun’s head with casual affection, and the normally imperious goat allowed the gesture freely, her arrogance somehow enhanced rather than diminished by her willingness to accept praise from one she deemed worthy.
After savoring this moment of agricultural triumph, Noah walked away from their plot toward the scattered figures who populated his Early Veiled Shore.

Some sat in meditative positions while others slept peacefully, but all of them radiated the gentle glow of beings whose complexity continued to rise through exposure to the concentrated authority that permeated every grain of sand!

As he approached them, Noah pulled upon the Refined Early Living Existential Glyph of Ascendancy, feeling its power respond to his will like a perfectly tuned instrument awaiting the touch of a master.
He remembered the words that had described its function with perfect clarity.
He could select certain beings as Ascendants, sharing growth that his own existence could not process quickly enough.

When an Ascendant reached the ten million marker in both Complexity and Purity, he would receive one Ascendancy Mark of Existence that could instantly establish any Tower of Osmont without the usual requirements!
Additional marks would be earned at fifty million and one hundred million quotient levels, while ten Marks would allow any Tower of Osmont to achieve its second stage instantaneously!
The implications were gloriously staggering.
Not only could he accelerate the advancement of those around him, but their progress would directly contribute to his own development in ways that created exponential growth patterns!
“All those here shall be Ascendants,” he uttered with calm certainty.
HUUM!
The Glyph of Ascendancy blazed to life with hues of white and gold that seemed to contain within their radiance the compressed essence of unlimited potential.

Above the heads of Moiraine, Adelaide, Barbatos, Henry, his mother, Liora, and many others, the same hazy glow of the Glyph appeared like crowns of light marking them as chosen recipients of his excess growth.
The connection formed instantly, creating pathways through which he could share the overwhelming development his existence generated!
And... the one thing that nearly caused his body to explode due to its potent weavings was the Sacred Mead of Existence that continued to accelerate every process beyond normal parameters.
Noah approached the crystal bucket containing the milky gold liquid that had already transformed his capabilities beyond recognition.

Without hesitation, he lifted it to his lips and took another gulp, consuming five hundred drops this time with the casual confidence of someone who had grown accustomed to handling forces that would destroy his other self just minuted ago!
His existence erupted with multicolored lights of primal and tribal grace as his complexity scaled upward once again.
The radiance that emanated from his form carried patterns that spoke to the earliest epochs of existence, when power flowed in lands and folds thst even Living Existences had not walked through!

Behind him, those he had marked as Ascendant experienced their own transformation. Their eyes fluttered as waves of shared advancement washed through their beings, their Complexities and Purities jumping by tens of thousands every second as they received the overflow from his accelerated development!
Noah nodded with satisfaction as he observed their progress, then focused his attention on one particular figure among the blessed recipients of his generosity.
Moiraine sat upon the golden sands like a statue carved from concentrated authority, her gorgeous white-gold figure utterly otherworldly in its perfection.
The radiance that surrounded her form seemed to bend light itself, creating patterns that hurt to observe directly for those weaker, yet drew the eye with magnetic inevitability.
“Moiraine,” Noah called with the calm authority of absolute command, a plan already unfolding in his mind as he thought about what the Living Paradoxes had managed to accomplish with Diviticus!
Her eyes fluttered open, glazed with burning complexity as the effects of shared advancement continued to course through her existence!

chapters.title: Chapter 3935: Power Must Be Taken! IV
paragraphs: She rose with fluid grace and came to stand beside Noah like a loyal soldier awaiting orders, this extremely powerful Prime Living Paradox displaying the kind of devotion that would have shocked anyone who understood her true capabilities!
Noah looked at her with the steady gaze as he spoke calmly.

“The Paradoxes have begun to move with Diviticus in the lead,” he said without preamble. “She has obtained something from me that allows her to pass through Paradoxical weavings without producing Inevitabilities. Using this capability....she led an assault on a heavily defended location and succeeded in stealing something the Coalition of Living Existences had protected for eons. A treasure that made them unfathomably powerful.”
Moiraine’s expression shifted to one of stern seriousness as she processed these words.
Her golden eyes blazed as she asked!
“What did they steal?” she asked this with the precise diction of someone who needed to understand every detail of a rapidly evolving situation!
“The corpse...of an Early Creature,” Noah replied with calm finality.
HUUM!
The shock that crossed Moiraine’s features was immediate!
She then showed anger.
As if she was expressing...how dare they?!
Both the Living Paradoxes and other Living Existences- how dare they desecrate a body of an Early Creature?!
She could not imagine it if it was the body of Noah before her that Living Existences held in their hands for eons.
It was true desecration!
Noah watched her reaction with approval before continuing.
“If a bit of myself taken by Diviticus can achieve all this, I will give a lot more of myself to you. Become...an Honored Living Paradox that does not produce Inevitabilities.”
BOOM!
The words were heavy.
Heavy!
Moiraine’s shock deepened as she stared at him with wide eyes, her voice barely above a whisper when she responded: “I could never...”
But Noah cut through her protest instantly, carrying the purple brilliance of Tyranny calmly here!
“You will,” he said with imposing authority. “Let me tell you about power, so that you can always remember its fundamental nature.”
Heidrun raised her head from thr distance and blinked as if she were wondering what the pristine Early Creature was saying now.

“Power... is not a gift to be bestowed by benevolent masters upon grateful others. Power is not charity dispensed by those who have it to those who lack it. Power is a force of nature that must be seized by those who possess the strength and will to claim it!”
HUUM!
” It can never be truly given because the act of giving implies that the recipient remains dependent upon the giver’s continued goodwill.”
His gaze fixed upon her with laser intensity, each word carefully chosen to cut through layers of conditioning and understanding!

“Right now, I want to give you power. I could force you to take it, could overwhelm your resistance and impose advancement upon your existence whether you desired it or not. But if I did that, you would never truly possess power. You would simply be a conduit for mine, forever limited by your own failure to choose greatness when it was offered freely.”
The silence that followed was burning with possibility, heavy with the weight of decisions that would echo across existence!
“So tell me, Moiraine,” he continued with calm tyrannical authority, “do you want power? Will you take the power I offer not as a gift but as something you claim through your own will and desire?”
His words struck her gloriously, each syllable resonating through the deepest foundations of her existence.
Moiraine’s eyes pulsed with growing firmness as understanding dawned, as she recognized that this moment would define her future capabilities along her fundamental nature as Living Paradox!
She stepped forward with decisive movement and knelt before him, her voice carrying the weight of absolute commitment when she spoke.
“I want it!”
WAA!
Noah nodded with the satisfaction.
His palm opened like a flower blooming in reverse, and drops of blood began flowing forth by the dozens, each one pulsing with the compressed essence of what it meant to be an Early Creature.
“Then take it.” he commanded with tyrannical authority that seemed to reshape the very air around them.
The very Early Veiled Shore shining around them!
One hundred dull crimson-gold drops of Blood flowed toward Moiraine like liquid starlight given purpose and direction.
They sank into her body through her skin and mouth, each drop carrying with it transformative power that would have destroyed lesser beings even as it elevated her beyond previous limitations.
In an instant, she began to radiate a terrifying flow of power that made the surrounding air shimmer with barely contained Living Existential Authority.
But Noah was not finished with his generosity!
Even as the Blood worked its transformation upon her cellular structure, he took the bucket of Sacred Mead of Existence and scooped a mouthful of the golden liquid.
He brought it toward Moiraine’s mouth with careful precision, allowing five hundred droplets of the miraculous substance to flow past her lips.
HUUM!
The reaction was immediate and overwhelming.

A terrifying eruption of complexity instantly exploded outward from Moiraine’s form, engulfing everything within sight in waves of transformative energy that spoke to forces beyond normal comprehension!
The very foundations of the Early Veiled Shore trembled as they absorbed and channeled power, while those marked as Ascendant found their own advancement accelerating beyond all previous parameters!
The golden sands beneath their feet pulsed with rhythm that echoed the heartbeat of existence itself, while the crystalline waters reflected light that had never existed before this moment!
In the distance, the newly planted Auric Vitae Grass swayed in harmony with forces that could never have been observed before.
This...was transformation in its purest form, the reshaping of a being’s fundamental nature through the application of power that existed beyond the normal categories of possibility!

And at its center stood Noah, Early Creature and an architect of tyrannical advancement, watching with satisfied eyes as his actions created ripples that would reshape the balance of power across all levels of existence.
Diviticus took half a drop of his blood? Okay!
Okay!
Let’s see what Living Existences could be raised with a hundred drops.
If that was not enough, then he would do it with 1,000 Drops of Blood!
He could go utterly crazy...in ways no Living Existences understood!

Noah looked at her with the steady gaze as he spoke calmly.
“The Paradoxes have begun to move with Diviticus in the lead,” he said without preamble.
“She has obtained something from me that allows her to pass through Paradoxical weavings without producing Inevitabilities.
Using this capability....she led an assault on a heavily defended location and succeeded in stealing something the Coalition of Living Existences had protected for eons.
A treasure that made them unfathomably powerful.”
Moiraine’s expression shifted to one of stern seriousness as she processed these words.
Her golden eyes blazed as she asked!
“What did they steal?” she asked this with the precise diction of someone who needed to understand every detail of a rapidly evolving situation!
“The corpse...of an Early Creature,” Noah replied with calm finality.
HUUM!
The shock that crossed Moiraine’s features was immediate!
She then showed anger.
As if she was expressing...how dare they?!
Both the Living Paradoxes and other Living Existences- how dare they desecrate a body of an Early Creature?!
She could not imagine it if it was the body of Noah before her that Living Existences held in their hands for eons.
It was true desecration!
Noah watched her reaction with approval before continuing.
“If a bit of myself taken by Diviticus can achieve all this, I will give a lot more of myself to you.
Become...an Honored Living Paradox that does not produce Inevitabilities.”
BOOM!
The words were heavy.
Heavy!
Moiraine’s shock deepened as she stared at him with wide eyes, her voice barely above a whisper when she responded: “I could never...”
But Noah cut through her protest instantly, carrying the purple brilliance of Tyranny calmly here!
“You will,” he said with imposing authority.
“Let me tell you about power, so that you can always remember its fundamental nature.”
Heidrun raised her head from thr distance and blinked as if she were wondering what the pristine Early Creature was saying now.

HUUM!

chapters.title: Chapter 3936: A Twitch! I
paragraphs: Noah stood surrounded by incandescent waves of light that pulsed with the rhythm of glorious transformation, his enhanced perception focused entirely upon the changes occurring within Moiraine as his Blood and Sacred Mead of Existence worked their fundamental alterations upon her very essence.
The combination of the Blood and Sacred Mead of Existence created reactions of magisterial tyranny, reshaping her capabilities and her nature as a Living Existence!
She seemed to barely be holding on as her complexity and purity surged upward in exponential curves.
Her form trembled with the effort of containing forces that pressed against the boundaries of what her existence could accommodate!
Then, in a moment that marked the crossing of an invisible threshold....
BOOM!
Her aura changed with the finality of a Wheel of Existence being born.
It became more pressing, heavier, carrying an undeniable weight that spoke to authority operating on entirely different principles than anything she had possessed before!
Where once her presence had been impressive, it now commanded attention. Deserved attention! Undoubtedly!
Noah smiled brilliantly as he observed this transformation, recognizing familiar patterns in the oppressive nature of her new aura.
From her, he now sensed a similar sense of suffocation that he had experienced when encountering beings like Honored Diviticus and Honored Gold.
She had crossed a fundamental threshold, ascending beyond the normal categories that defined Prime Living Existences.
But her transformation was only beginning.
Her figure began to rise from the golden sands of the Shore, her feet leaving the crystalline surface while her body maintained perfect stability in the air above.

Her eyes and mouth opened simultaneously, releasing streams of dull crimson-gold light that formed into tendrils which descended back toward the earth before wrapping around her form like ceremonial garments woven from pure authority!
The sight was magnificent and terrifying to observe!
New information began cascading across Noah’s consciousness as existence itself buzzed.
|The Ascendant Moiraine is undergoing existential evolution from a Living Existence to an Arch Living Existence, a transformation that expands the very boundaries of what she can become.|
|Her possible weavings of existence have been fundamentally expanded. She can now achieve things that were previously impossible, transcending limitations that bound her previous form.|

|An Arch Living Existence is capable of holding two Living Existential Authorities simultaneously if proper conditions are met. Living Existential Authority density and depth of complexity and purity is increased by factor of five. Glyph formation rates accelerated by 300%. Resistance to existential manipulation increased exponentially. It is possible to exceed the 100% cap of a resistance through the aid of an Early Creature.|
WAA!
The implications were gloriously maddening.
An Arch Living Existence represented a complete departure from normal progression of Living Existences!
The beams of crimson-gold light shooting from her eyes and mouth began sinking back into her form, their energy transforming as it merged with her essence.
The result was spectacular beyond description...nine blazing dull crimson-gold halos materialized around her head, each one bearing a pair of archaic wings that moved with their own subtle rhythm.
The halos...had wings!
When her eyes finally opened, they carried a terrifying glow of power that was fundamentally different from anything Noah had observed in other Living Existences.
Noah observed her advancement and nodded with contentment.

|The Ascendant Moiraine has long ago exceeded the ten million and one hundred million markers, but has achieved such vast advancement in complexity and purity since being designated as an Ascendant that fifty Ascendancy Marks of Existence have been obtained from her transformation alone.|
|From other Ascendants present in the Early Veiled Shore, an additional twenty-five Ascendancy Marks of Existence have been generated through shared advancement.|
The set of prompts were glorious ones.
Quintessential ones!
A total of seventy-five Ascendancy Marks of Existence obtained in a single moment of transformation!
Noah’s eyes shone as he contemplated the possibilities that such a number represented.

Seventy-five marks meant he could either establish seventy-five new Towers of Osmont at their first stage, each granting five hundred thousand in both Complexity and Purity, or advance seven existing towers to their second stage, gaining two million in each quotient...plus a Basic Early Living Existential Glyph for each type of Tower.
The choice between breadth and depth carried significant implications for his future development.
Well, he said future but really, it would mainly matter in the next few hours...or a day or two at most!

More first-stage towers would provide steady growth and diversification of capabilities, while advancing existing towers to their second stage would create...Sacred Totems that could potentially attract additional Early Living Land Lifeforms like Heidrun.
After a moment of deliberation, Noah’s eyes flashed with glorious tyranny as he made his decision.
The reason became clear as his gaze shifted toward Heidrun, who continued to observe her newly planted green-gold grass with imperial satisfaction and arrogance!
What was the reason he currently possessed an Eminent Early Living Land Lifeform? The answer lay in the Sacred Totem of Infinity that had drawn her across impossible distances to answer his call!

“Use the Ascendancy Marks of Existence to advance the Quintessential Tower, the Ascendancy Tower, the Protagonist Tower, the Loot Tower, Tyranny Tower, Paradox Tower, and Origin Tower,” he commanded with cold precision.
HUUM!
He gave the command, and things began to unfold.

His existence buzzed with glory as changes began occurring! His muscles undulated as if an utterly terrifying foundation was continuing to be forged within the architecture of his very essence, each fiber of his form adapting to accommodate new levels of Existence.

|The following Early Sacred Living Towers of Osmont are being advanced to their Second Stage completion: Quintessential Tower, Ascendancy Tower, Protagonist Tower, Loot Tower, Tyranny Tower, Paradox Tower, and Origin Tower. New Sacred Totems will soon be born.|
His body exploded with waves of immensity that made the surrounding air shimmer with barely contained authority!
The transformation was visible in every line of his form, from the way his skin seemed to glow with inner radiance to the manner in which his very presence began warping the space around him.
Towers formed.
And very soon, Sacred Totems would also form!
At this moment of his own fundamental elevation, Noah looked toward Moiraine, who remained suspended in her ongoing transformation.
Her new eyes, shining with dull crimson-gold radiance, regarded him with expressions of shock and even grander respect.
“We are not done,” he said with calm finality.
Her newly transformed eyes pulsed with power as she felt her Existence tighten with anticipation and perhaps a touch of caution.
“What...else could Sir be thinking of?” she asked carefully.
Noah tapped out with his finger and sent a concentrated burst of information directly into her consciousness.
When the transfer was complete, he spoke.

“A certain amount of complexity and purity will form either a Basic, Refined, Eminent, or Kleos Glyph. An Eminent Glyph requires one hundred million Complexity and Purity Quotients, while a Kleos Glyph demands one billion. Form as many Eminent and Kleos Glyphs as you can manage.”
Moiraine’s seriousness was visible in every line of her elevated form as she nodded with newfound understanding.
She thought.
And she then moved!
Her weavings of Existence began to transform, preparing to sacrifice vast quantities of complexity and purity for even grander power.
|The Arch Living Existence, the Ascendant Moiraine, can form up to Eminent Glyphs with her current distinction and proximity to an Early Creature serving as catalyst for the process.|
|The Ascendant Moiraine has sacrificed an initial ten billion CQ and PQ to simultaneously form one hundred Eminent Early Living Existential Glyphs of Paradox.|
Even Noah felt a moment of surprise at the magnitude of what she was doing right off!
One hundred Eminent Early Living Existential Glyphs!
What followed was a sight that would have driven Fold Dwellers to their knees in reverence or terror.
One hundred points of singularities bloomed across Moiraine’s body like Wheels being born in miniature, each one marking the genesis of a Glyph whose power would reshape her weavings of Existence.
The moment this process began, Moiraine alone released such a terrifying archaic air of age that the very sands of the Early Veiled Shore began to resonate!
The crystalline waters at the shoreline reflected her radiance while the three ancient trees swayed in response!

Even Heidrun momentarily stopped her calm observation of the green-gold grass plot, her imperial composure cracking as surprise and what appeared to be recognition flickered through her crystalline eyes!

The goat’s reaction spoke to depths of knowledge and records in its lineage that stretched back to epochs when such transformations were more common, when Early Creatures did such actions easily and without evem sparing much thought.
Moiraine’s transformation continued to unfold with terrifying beauty, each Glyph that formed upon her body adding new layers to her already overwhelming presence!
Looking at her suspended form, radiant with the light of one hundred newly formed Glyphs, Noah laughed with Tyranny and glory, his voice carrying across the Shore.
“Continue! Continue! You shall be one of my finest designs!”
The words rang across the Early Veiled Shore like a proclamation!
In the distance, the newly planted Auric Vitae Grass swayed in rhythm, while the crystalline waters witnessed everything.
They witnessed!

chapters.title: Chapter 3937: A Twitch! II
paragraphs: As Noah observed his own transformation and the elevation of Moiraine in the Early Veiled Shore, the reverberations of their advancement would eventually ripple across the vast expanse of Existence itself.
Eventually.
But they were not the only ones experiencing fundamental change in this moment of existential significance.
Existence is vast, unexplored, and filled with wonder beyond the comprehension of most conscious beings.
What many commonly know and understand represents but a mere fractional facet of the true Weavings of Existence that stretch across infinite possibilities.

In these grand unexplored territories dwell countless entities who are exceptional in their own right, masters of their own fables, beings whose choices carry weight that affects far more than they could ever imagine.

And in the Transcendent Paradoxical Folds, a countless distance away from the conflicts and revelations unfolding elsewhere, such choices were being made that would reshape the very foundations upon which some parts of existence operated!
In the Heart of Paradox, nestled within the deepest regions of the Transcendent Paradoxical Folds, lay a domain of wonder.

Stellar obsidian and gold rivers of Living Paradoxical Authority flowed through the landscape in patterns that hurt to observe directly, their currents carrying contradictions that made reality itself seem uncertain of its own nature.
At the center of this impossible realm stood a massive statue that dominated the horizon with its sheer presence.
The figure was carved from materials that existed in states of perpetual contradiction, its form both solid and ethereal, ancient and newly forged.
In its hands, it held a weapon that defied rational description....an obsidian infinity symbol whose very existence seemed to challenge the fundamental weavings governing reality.
The robed statue wore a crown that pulsed with its own inner radiance, its features carved into the likeness of a terrifying Paradoxical Emperor whose gaze overlooked everything within this domain.

There was something unsettling about those stone eyes, as if they contained awareness that transcended the merely artistic, consciousness trapped within unchanging material that watched and judged with paradoxical patience!
Yet where its gaze fell now, thousands upon thousands of terrifying Living Paradoxes circled a certain area with wills of power that made the surrounding air shimmer with barely contained authority.

The assembly was unprecedented in its scope and significance- thousands of Prime Living Paradoxes formed outer rings of observation, while close to one hundred Honored Living Paradoxes occupied positions of greater prominence.
Among these Honored beings stood Gold, his form radiating the particular brand of ancient authority.
But even he, for all his accumulated power and wisdom, showed deference to the ten figures who commanded the ultimate positions of authority in this gathering.
Duke Elagabalus sat grandly upon an obsidian throne constructed from hundreds of miniaturized Wheels of Existence, each one pulsing with its own rhythm of contained reality.
His terrifying obsidian-gold hair flowed like liquid metal around his shoulders, while his crimson-gold robe seemed to absorb and reflect light Paradoxically!
Above his head floated a three-pointed crown that pulsed with authority so concentrated it made the surrounding space bend subtly around its presence.

Beside him and arranged in careful formation sat nine other entities, each occupying thrones of different colors and materials but all sharing the same fundamental nature...they were Dukes, ten of the eighty-one beings who collectively governed the fate of all Living Paradoxes across existence.
Their presence here spoke to the significance of whatever had drawn them together in this place of ancient power!
All of their attention was focused upon a single object that lay before them like a sacrifice offered to forgotten wonders.
Near Duke Elagabalus stood none other than Diviticus, though her visage now shimmered with an extremely brilliant white grandeur that spoke to fundamental changes in her nature and status.
She seemed untouchable, wrapped in a unique authority that made even the assembled Dukes regard her with respect!
Many of the gathered Paradoxes looked toward her with expressions of awe.
But...what commanded their collective attention was a body- the corpse they had stolen from the Coalition of Living Existences through audacious assault and impossible capability.
It was the preserved remains of an Early Creature, a being whose death should have been inconceivable yet whose body lay before them as undeniable proof that even the mightiest could fall!

The corpse was massive in scale, perhaps ten times the size of any Living Paradox present, its proportions telling of the fundamental differences between Early Creatures and the beings who had evolved in their wake.

The most striking feature was the wound that had ended its existence- a diagonal cleave that ran from shoulder to waist, cutting through flesh and bone with such precision that no trace of energy remained to indicate what force could have delivered such a devastating blow!
Yet when even Honored Living Existences gazed upon that wound, they felt their hearts shake with the understanding that if such a strike were directed toward them, they would crumble like dust!

The corpse appeared humanoid in its basic structure. Around its waist was wrapped what appeared to be clothing fashioned from animal hide, though the materials were unlike anything that existed in current reality.
The garment suggested primitive origins yet radiated an aura of authority that made it clear this being had needed no external symbols to command respect!
Its upper body lay bare, revealing the full extent of the massive wound while simultaneously displaying the fundamental differences between Early Creature physiology and that of lesser beings.
Apart from the diagonal cut that had ended its existence, the skin and muscle appeared completely drained of blood, their color faded to a gray that spoke to death in its most absolute form.
Yet paradoxically, even in death, the corpse carried waves of life that far exceeded even the Royal Living Paradoxes present!
It was as if death itself had been unable to fully claim this being, leaving behind something that existed in the space between existence and nonexistence.
All across its body, one could observe indentations and excavations where countless entities had worked over eons to extract samples of skin, muscle, and bone.

Also prominent...were thousands of terrifying Glyphs that seemed broken and carved out, with each shattered Glyph causing any Honored Living Existence who looked at it to feel a sense of oppression! From a simple one...of the thousands of broken Glyphs!

The Coalition of Living Existences had clearly been harvesting from this corpse for an unimaginable length of time, each extraction representing attempts to understand or replicate the fundamental nature and power of Early Creature existence.
Most shocking of all was the absence of the heart, clearly removed through careful surgical precision by something far more powerful than a Living Existence!

Among these Honored beings stood Gold, his form radiating the particular brand of ancient authority.
But even he, for all his accumulated power and wisdom, showed deference to the ten figures who commanded the ultimate positions of authority in this gathering.
Duke Elagabalus sat grandly upon an obsidian throne constructed from hundreds of miniaturized Wheels of Existence, each one pulsing with its own rhythm of contained reality.
His terrifying obsidian-gold hair flowed like liquid metal around his shoulders, while his crimson-gold robe seemed to absorb and reflect light Paradoxically!
Above his head floated a three-pointed crown that pulsed with authority so concentrated it made the surrounding space bend subtly around its presence.

Beside him and arranged in careful formation sat nine other entities, each occupying thrones of different colors and materials but all sharing the same fundamental nature...they were Dukes, ten of the eighty-one beings who collectively governed the fate of all Living Paradoxes across existence.
Their presence here spoke to the significance of whatever had drawn them together in this place of ancient power!
All of their attention was focused upon a single object that lay before them like a sacrifice offered to forgotten wonders.
Near Duke Elagabalus stood none other than Diviticus, though her visage now shimmered with an extremely brilliant white grandeur that spoke to fundamental changes in her nature and status.
She seemed untouchable, wrapped in a unique authority that made even the assembled Dukes regard her with respect!
Many of the gathered Paradoxes looked toward her with expressions of awe.
But...what commanded their collective attention was a body- the corpse they had stolen from the Coalition of Living Existences through audacious assault and impossible capability.
It was the preserved remains of an Early Creature, a being whose death should have been inconceivable yet whose body lay before them as undeniable proof that even the mightiest could fall!

The corpse was massive in scale, perhaps ten times the size of any Living Paradox present, its proportions telling of the fundamental differences between Early Creatures and the beings who had evolved in their wake.

The most striking feature was the wound that had ended its existence- a diagonal cleave that ran from shoulder to waist, cutting through flesh and bone with such precision that no trace of energy remained to indicate what force could have delivered such a devastating blow!
Yet when even Honored Living Existences gazed upon that wound, they felt their hearts shake with the understanding that if such a strike were directed toward them, they would crumble like dust!
The corpse appeared humanoid in its basic structure.
Around its waist was wrapped what appeared to be clothing fashioned from animal hide, though the materials were unlike anything that existed in current reality.
The garment suggested primitive origins yet radiated an aura of authority that made it clear this being had needed no external symbols to command respect!
Its upper body lay bare, revealing the full extent of the massive wound while simultaneously displaying the fundamental differences between Early Creature physiology and that of lesser beings.
Apart from the diagonal cut that had ended its existence, the skin and muscle appeared completely drained of blood, their color faded to a gray that spoke to death in its most absolute form.
Yet paradoxically, even in death, the corpse carried waves of life that far exceeded even the Royal Living Paradoxes present!
It was as if death itself had been unable to fully claim this being, leaving behind something that existed in the space between existence and nonexistence.
All across its body, one could observe indentations and excavations where countless entities had worked over eons to extract samples of skin, muscle, and bone.
Also prominent...were thousands of terrifying Glyphs that seemed broken and carved out, with each shattered Glyph causing any Honored Living Existence who looked at it to feel a sense of oppression!
From a simple one...of the thousands of broken Glyphs!

The Coalition of Living Existences had clearly been harvesting from this corpse for an unimaginable length of time, each extraction representing attempts to understand or replicate the fundamental nature and power of Early Creature existence.
Most shocking of all was the absence of the heart, clearly removed through careful surgical precision by something far more powerful than a Living Existence!

chapters.title: Chapter 3938: A Twitch! III
paragraphs: The network of vessels that remained revealed blood cells that defied conventional understandingz they appeared as gray, lifeless Wheels of Existence, suggesting that even in death, the corpse’s circulatory system operated according to principles that transcended understanding.
The archaic air that emanated from the corpse created an atmosphere of wonder mixed with terror.
Its head retained features that might once have been noble or beautiful, though death had transformed them into something terrifying.
The eyes were blacked out, creating endless abysses that seemed to stare into dimensions that existed beyond current reality!
Its hair remained wild and untamed, dark gray strands that held their original configuration despite the complete absence of life!
Every Living Paradox present gazed upon this impossible sight with eyes that shone with mixture of hunger, fear, and desperate hope.
In the heavy silence that followed their collective observation, the voice of Duke Elagabalus echoed across the gathering with the weight of glorious proclamation.
He looked toward Diviticus with an expression that combined respect with calculation, his words carrying implications that would reshape the hierarchy of their entire weavings of existence!

“I do not think my proposition of making Honored Diviticus a member of the council and granting her the rank of Duke will meet with any complaints now. Through her aid, we were able to obtain something we could only envy for eons!”
HUUM!
All eyes turned to regard both the speaker and the subject of his declaration, the magnitude of what had been achieved finally settling into their weavings with proper weight.

Duke Elagabalus smiled toward Diviticus with satisfaction that bordered on pride. “Duke Diviticus, why don’t you be the first to study the corpse that the Coalition of Living Existences has been feeding from all these eons so they could match our power? The rest of the council will call for it to be veiled and hidden away soon!”
Duke Diviticus!
DUKE!

No longer merely Honored, but elevated to one of the highest ranks their weavings could bestow. She might not yet possess the accumulated strength that typically accompanied such position, but the title she now held carried authority that transcended mere power!
She nodded with eyes that shone with anticipation and calm glory.
As she approached the massive corpse, she felt waves of awe and veneration washing over her being.

The corpse lay motionless, yet her very existence pulsed with wonder and interminable glory at simply being in its presence. She moved forward with careful steps until she stood before the massive form, its scale making her feel insignificant despite her newly elevated status.
With trembling hand, she reached out and touched a single finger of the corpse...just the finger alone, which was itself larger than her entire torso.
It should have been something simple, a mere contact between living flesh and dead tissue.
And yet in the next moment, the impossible occurred.
HUUM!
The surface of the corpse instantly began buzzing and trembling!
The finger she had touched twitched once...a single, involuntary movement that lasted no more than a heartbeat.
A twitch. Just one twitch.
Goodness, just one twitch!
But it was so terrifying in its implications that the instant this movement was seen and felt, every Living Paradox present was overwhelmed by primal terror. .

No matter what distinction they held, no matter how much power they had accumulated or how many conflicts they had survived...Prime, Honored, Royal, Duke...every single one scattered into lights of pure panic and fled for their existence.
Instantly!
From observing that one twitch!
They ran with the desperate urgency of beings who had suddenly realized they stood in the presence of something that could erase them from reality without effort!

Light-years disappeared in seconds as they put distance between themselves and the source of their terror, their only thought being escape from whatever force could make a dead Early Creature respond to touch.
Duke Diviticus found herself among those who fled, her newly elevated status providing no protection against the instinctive horror that had seized her Living Existential Authority!

She ran until she was light-years away before managing to stop and look back, her enhanced perception confirming that the twitch had been singular...after she had released contact, the corpse had returned to its previous state of absolute stillness.
She breathed heavily with shock that made her entire form tremble, her heart pulsing with rhythms that spoke to terror mixed with unprecedented shock.
Slowly, carefully, she began to return, her eyes wide with the knowledge that she had just witnessed something that defied every understanding of existence.
One by one, the thrones of Dukes began to reappear in the distance, their occupants peering from afar with expressions of shock and profound seriousness.
Only when they confirmed that the corpse had returned to complete motionlessness did they dare to approach again, their movements cautious as prey animals checking for predators.
Immense silence followed their gradual return, heavy with weavings that none of them fully understood but all recognized as monumentally significant.
In this moment of utter shock and tension, Duke Elagabalus fixed his gaze upon the still-trembling Diviticus.
His eyes flashed sharply as understanding began to dawn, and he turned to command one of the Honored Living Paradoxes behind him.
“Touch the corpse,” he ordered with stern authority that brooked no argument.
The Honored being was initially hesitant, his earlier terror still fresh in memory, but the duke’s unwavering gaze left no room for refusal.
He approached the massive form....and hesitantly made contact with its surface.
Slowly!
This was how much Living Existences revered and feared Early Creatures!
The moment stretched as every observer held their breath, ready to scatter again at the first sign of movement.
But...nothing happened. Nothing at all.
Duke Elagabalus and others stared in shock as the implications became clear, their collective attention turning toward Diviticus with expressions that mixed awe with growing excitement.
Before anyone could voice their thoughts, she was already floating toward the corpse again, her own curiosity overcoming her earlier terror.
She went forward again and reached out. This time, she touched the toe of the massive foot with deliberate precision.
And once again, the impossible occurred.
HUUM!
A booming flash of terrifying aura erupted from the point of contact as the toe twitched with the same involuntary response that had sent them all fleeing moments before.
Diviticus released contact immediately, her face showing a complex mixture of shock, terror, and exhilaration that spoke to discoveries!
Glorious discoveries!
She turned to look at the other Dukes and Honored Gold, and in their shared expression of fear mixed with tremendous excitement, they all recognized that they had stumbled upon a terrifying finding.
A finding that seemed to be uniquely centered around Duke Diviticus and her interaction with this corpse of an Early Creature!
What was this?! What could they do with this?!
Oh!
