chapters.title: Chapter 3939: Oh! I
paragraphs: Communication exists in countless forms throughout the vast expanse of existence.
Words spoken aloud carry meaning from one consciousness to another.
Actions taken with purpose convey intentions that transcend mere verbal expression.
Symbols and gestures create bridges between minds that might otherwise remain forever isolated!
Through these varied methods, understanding flows between beings like water finding its natural course.
Yet...there exist rare and precious moments when communication transcends all conventional boundaries.
Instances when harmony reaches such perfect resonance that even without words or symbols, without deliberate action or conscious thought, mere gazes become sufficient to convey the deepest truths.
In these extraordinary circumstances, eyes speak volumes that entire libraries could never contain, and understanding passes between beings with the immediacy and speed of light!
At this moment in time, within the Heart of Paradox surrounded by rivers of obsidian and gold authority, such a unique phenomenon was occurring.

In the aftermath of their collective flight from the impossible twitch of dead flesh responding to living touch, the assembled Living Paradoxes had returned to find themselves witnesses to something that challenged every assumption they held about the nature of existence itself.

The massive corpse of the Early Creature lay before them unchanged, yet the knowledge of what they had witnessed transformed everything about how they perceived both it and the being who had triggered its response.
Initially, their gazes carried expressions of pure shock mixed with exhilaration that bordered on euphoria.
Duke Elagabalus and Diviticus exchanged looks.
Honored Gold’s ancient eyes blazed with recognition of possibilities that stretched toward horizons he had never dared imagine.

The fact that Diviticus could cause a corpse of an Early Creature to react while others could not meant that something within her current status, some fundamental aspect of what she had become, allowed for this unprecedented interaction.
All of this understanding passed between them through nothing more than shared glances, their expressions communicating complex chains of reasoning without need for verbal confirmation.

Shock gave way to joy as they recognized the magnitude of what they had discovered, the potential that lay before them like an unopened treasure vault whose contents could reshape the balance of power across all of existence!
But then, without a single word being spoken, their collective expressions began to shift.
From exhilaration to confusion, the change occurred with such synchronicity that it might have been choreographed by unseen hands.
Each face reflected the same troubling question that had begun to surface in their minds like a bubble rising from deep waters.
Why would Diviticus alone possess this capability? What was it about her transformation that created such a unique reaction?

Nobody uttered these questions verbally or even formed them as conscious thoughts, yet they all looked at each other with perfect understanding of the uncertainty that had begun to gnaw at their earlier certainty.
The confusion painted itself across their features with unmistakable clarity, creating a moment of shared bewilderment that needed no explanation.
Then, as if guided by the same invisible force that had synchronized their confusion, their faces began to change again. From puzzlement to dawning realization!

Diviticus looked directly at Honored Gold, her gaze carrying the weight of recognition. The only reason she possessed this unprecedented capability was because she had consumed the body of Ozymandias.

She had obtained half a drop of his blood, and somehow that infinitesimal portion of his essence had granted her the ability to not produce inevitabilities and to interact with an Early Creature’s corpse to cause it to twitch!
Simultaneously, every Living Paradox present arrived at this same conclusion through their own chains of reasoning.
And right after this moment of collective understanding, their expressions underwent another synchronized transformation.
From realization to somber gravity, the change reflected minds grappling with implications that threatened to overwhelm their ability to process.
Oh.
They all looked at each other with the same terrible awareness dawning behind their eyes.
There were precious few reasons why the being that Diviticus had partially devoured could possess something that would react with the body of an Early Creature!
Either Ozymandias had carried some inheritance or connection to an Early Creature, or...
Oh!
The alternative was too enormous, too terrifying in its implications to fully contemplate.
The moment such possibilities began to surface in their consciousness, their faces collectively drained of color!
Without speaking a word, without exchanging so much as a gesture, they all felt the same chill settling into their bones as the unthinkable began to seem not merely possible but probable.
Diviticus began to pant, her breathing becoming rapid and shallow as the weight of realization pressed down upon her like a physical force!
She looked between Honored Gold and Duke Elagabalus, her head shaking in small, desperate movements that spoke to denial so profound it bordered on panic.
This expression of rejection spread through their ranks like a contagion, each face reflecting the same desperate need to reject what their minds were trying to tell them!
Even without words, they communicated their shared refusal to accept the possibility that Ozymandias could have been an Early Creature himself!
No. He had to have been someone with an inheritance. A bearer of some treasured connection. Maybe.
Their wordless communication continued as emotions cycled through them with the inexorable rhythm of grief itself.
Denial gave way to anger as the gathered Paradoxes turned their gazes toward Diviticus with expressions that held her responsible for consuming something that might have been infinitely precious.
The accusation in their eyes was clear- she was the one who had devoured him, who had potentially destroyed something irreplaceable.
But anger could not be sustained in the face of honest self-reflection.

Their expressions shifted to something approaching bargaining as they recognized, each in their own way, that any of them would have done the same thing given the opportunity. The blame could not rest solely on her shoulders when they all would have made identical choices.
Oh!
Depression followed as surely as night follows day.
Their gazes became haunted as they contemplated what they might have lost, what connection to Early Creature heritage might have been severed forever through their actions.
The weight of potential tragedy settled upon them like a shroud woven from regret and missed opportunity.

They looked at each other with expressions of shared numbness, each face reflecting the same dazed incomprehension of beings who had discovered that their greatest triumph might simultaneously be their most catastrophic failure.
Throughout this entire emotional journey, not a single word had been spoken.
Yet everyone understood each other with perfect clarity, their shared experience creating a harmony of communication that transcended all conventional boundaries!
At such a moment came... acceptance mixed with a desperate form of bargaining, hope clinging to rational explanation like a drowning man grasping for a savior.
It was Duke Elagabalus who finally broke the heavy silence that had settled over them like a funeral pall. His voice carried conviction born from desperate need to believe his own words.

"That Ozymandias could not have been an Early Creature. Otherwise, he would not have come to us as merely an Originus Venerant. Even weaker than that. Early Creatures at birth would be many times grander than any Honored Living Existence. The very concept defies logical possibility. So it cannot be possible. It is not possible."
Oh?!

chapters.title: Chapter 3940: Oh! II
paragraphs: Duke Elagabalus spoke with such firmness that for a moment, the weight of doubt seemed to lift from their collective consciousness.
There was immense silence as his words settled into their minds, but Diviticus and others nodded with gazes full of desperate hope.
Duke Elagabalus continued with growing confidence, his voice taking on the tone of someone who had found solid ground in a landscape of shifting possibilities.

"It is likely that he obtained an inheritance or treasure relating to an Early Creature. Perhaps a drop of blood from some ancient source, and that is what Diviticus obtained half of. Which means we must find Ozymandias at all costs. If he possesses such a treasure, it belongs with us. There is no harm being...friendly. Inviting him to our ranks truly."
Oh!
Their eyes blazed with collective acknowledgment as they seized upon this explanation like salvation itself.
All of them worked together to push down and deny the alternative possibility, burying it beneath layers of rational argument and desperate hope.
It was not possible that Ozymandias had been an Early Creature. It did not make sense given what they had observed. So they denied it, cast it aside, refused to give it space in their thoughts.
Denial became their shared truth, their collective protection against possibilities too vast to accept.
Duke Elagabalus looked toward the massive corpse that had started this entire chain of revelation, his expression brightening with newfound purpose.

"If from that inheritance, Diviticus truly holds half a drop of Early Creature blood, let us see if you can use your existence to reanimate and control this corpse that reacts to you. Perhaps you could act as its missing heart, become the vital force that gives it motion and purpose."
His voice grew stronger as the possibilities multiplied in his mind.

"If you achieve this, then the Living Paradoxes will have a genuine Early Creature fighting on our behalf. At that time, what worries would we have? What force in all of existence could stand against us?"
They looked at each other and nodded with expressions that mixed hope with determination.
Their collective gaze spoke volumes about their shared decision to embrace this path forward, to transform potential catastrophe into ultimate triumph.
Right.
It had to be this way.
It had to be possible!
It had to!
Oh!!!
Time passed, as it always did, being the single terrifying construct that no being could stand against.
When one contemplated all the cold and vile entities across existence and considered their kill counts, nobody could surpass the numbers that were naturally claimed by time itself.
Empires crumbled, stars died, Omniverses perished, Wheels of Existence underwent Breakings, civilizations rose and fell... all according to its inexorable rhythm!
Yet time also brought progress, advancement, and the steady accumulation of power that transformed the possible into the inevitable.
In the Early Veiled Shore, with the passage of time came accomplishments that defied the normal boundaries of what beings could achieve.
Progression unfolded here according to principles that existed beyond the understanding of others, each moment bringing transformations that would have taken others lifetimes to accomplish!
The scene that greeted Noah’s enhanced perception was one of sublime beauty touched with power that made the very air shimmer with possibility.
Moiraine’s visage descended slowly through the golden atmosphere of the Shore, her feet finally touching the crystalline sands with the gentle grace.
Her nine winged halos rotated around her head with subtle movements, each wing bearing patterns that hurt to observe directly yet drew the eye with magnetic inevitability!

Her skin shone with white-gold radiance that seemed to emanate from within rather than reflecting external light, creating an aura of otherworldly beauty that marked her as something fundamentally different from other Living Existences.
But it was the addition of the Eminent Early Living Existential Glyphs of Paradox that truly transformed her appearance into something that belonged to the earliest epochs of Existence!

The golden glyphs covered her body in intricate patterns that made her look like an archaic tribal being touched by unknown authority, each marking pulsing with its own weaving while contributing to a greater symphony of power.

Around her form, tendrils of Paradox swirled passively like storm clouds burning with potential destruction, their movements suggesting barely contained forces that could erupt at any moment to reshape existence according to her will!

Currently, five hundred swirling Eminent Early Living Existential Glyphs of Paradox adorned her being, each one representing a sacrifice of one hundred million in both Complexity and Purity Quotients.
The numbers were staggering- fifty billion units of power refined into permanent enhancements that would reshape her capabilities forever!
To understand the magnitude of what she had achieved, one needed to comprehend the demarcations of power that governed existence itself.
The peak of Originus Venerant entities stood at 99,999,999 in both Complexity and Purity.
Spilling past this threshold, one entered the realm of power that most normal Living Existences wielded, ranging from one hundred million to nine hundred ninety-nine million.
From one billion to ninety-nine billion marked the varying power levels of Prime Living Existences, while Honored ones exceeded the one hundred billion marker in both quotients!
Moiraine, the glorious Ascendant, the Arch Living Existence who had transcended normal categories through Noah’s gifts and her own determination, was now firmly established among such beings!

Noah sat upon the golden sands of the Early Veiled Shore, his expression one of calm satisfaction as he observed her descent. The smile that played across his features carried the particular joy of someone whose careful investment had yielded returns beyond his most optimistic projections.
Before him, new information began cascading across his consciousness as the Early Veiled Shore recognized and catalogued the implications of what had been achieved!

|By experiencing the advancement of the Arch Living Existence, Moiraine, and witnessing her formation of multiple hundred Eminent Glyphs, you have understood Eminent Glyphs on a fundamental level. The requirement to form your own Eminent Glyphs has been reduced from 100 Million to 75 Million.|
Oh?!

There was immense silence as his words settled into their minds, but Diviticus and others nodded with gazes full of desperate hope.
Duke Elagabalus continued with growing confidence, his voice taking on the tone of someone who had found solid ground in a landscape of shifting possibilities.
"It is likely that he obtained an inheritance or treasure relating to an Early Creature.
Perhaps a drop of blood from some ancient source, and that is what Diviticus obtained half of.
Which means we must find Ozymandias at all costs.
If he possesses such a treasure, it belongs with us.
There is no harm being...friendly.
Inviting him to our ranks truly."
Oh!
Their eyes blazed with collective acknowledgment as they seized upon this explanation like salvation itself.
All of them worked together to push down and deny the alternative possibility, burying it beneath layers of rational argument and desperate hope.
It was not possible that Ozymandias had been an Early Creature.
It did not make sense given what they had observed.
So they denied it, cast it aside, refused to give it space in their thoughts.
Denial became their shared truth, their collective protection against possibilities too vast to accept.
Duke Elagabalus looked toward the massive corpse that had started this entire chain of revelation, his expression brightening with newfound purpose.
"If from that inheritance, Diviticus truly holds half a drop of Early Creature blood, let us see if you can use your existence to reanimate and control this corpse that reacts to you.
Perhaps you could act as its missing heart, become the vital force that gives it motion and purpose."
His voice grew stronger as the possibilities multiplied in his mind.
"If you achieve this, then the Living Paradoxes will have a genuine Early Creature fighting on our behalf.
At that time, what worries would we have?
What force in all of existence could stand against us?"
They looked at each other and nodded with expressions that mixed hope with determination.

Right.

chapters.title: Chapter 3941: Oh! III
paragraphs: The implications were significant!

Through observation and proximity to her transformation, his own understanding had deepened to the point where he could achieve similar feats with greater efficiency. It was yet another demonstration of how the Early Veiled Shore facilitated advancement through shared experience and collective growth.
Another prompt appeared with information that made him turn to survey his domain.
|Seven additional Sacred Totems have been enacted in the Early Veiled Shore, manifesting the completed Second Stage Towers of Osmont.|
Noah’s gaze swept across the landscape as he observed the newly manifested structures scattered throughout different areas of the Shore.

Each Sacred Totem bore similar fundamental architecture to the original Totem of Infinity, yet each possessed its own unique characteristics that spoke to the distinct nature of the Tower it represented.
Different colors dominated their crystalline surfaces, while ancient-looking bells crowned their peaks with designs filled with quintessential glory.
The sight was magnificent, speaking to accumulated power that had been refined into permanent monuments to his advancement.
Yet even as he admired their beauty, another prompt appeared that tempered his satisfaction with practical limitations!

|Until the Early Veiled Shore advances from its current Budding status, it cannot support another Early Living Land Lifeform as the ringing of any bells will not call forth anything. The Early Living Land Lifeform, Heidrun, has occupied an immense breadth of existence provided by the Shore for Land Lifeforms. Additional capacity requires fundamental expansion of the Shore itself.|
Oh...

The Sacred Totems were built and ready to serve their purpose, yet he could not ring their bells to call forth terrifying creatures like Heidrun until the Shore itself evolved to accommodate such expansion!
He shook his head at this limitation with rueful amusement, recognizing that even in a realm of impossible wonders, certain boundaries still applied.
As Noah’s gaze moved across the Sacred Totems, it naturally fell upon other figures who populated his domain, each representing their own remarkable journey of advancement and transformation.

Ruination and the Infiniverse no longer competed to exceed one another in complexity, their rivalry having evolved into something more cooperative as they focused on becoming more complex both for themselves and for him.
Ruination had made tremendous advances despite her relatively modest baseline complexity and purity, which remained less than one million.
Less than 1 Million!
Yet...she shockingly held eleven Basic Early Living Existential Glyphs of Ruination alongside two Refined Early Living Existential Glyphs of Ruination!

The combination equated to more than thirty million in effective Complexity, creating a situation where even if a being appeared before her with thirty million actual complexity and purity, with only a single Refined Glyph...she would be able to defeat them with casual ease!
The Infiniverse presented an entirely different case study in advancement.
She had not generated massive waves of power or undergone dramatic eruptions of authority, yet among all those present, with the sole exception of Moiraine, she was the one who had advanced the most.
Her progress was monstrous in its scope, achieved through methods that were...a bit off compared to others!
She possessed Refined Early Living Existential Glyphs of Manadynamics, Infinity, Continuity, Dreams, and Entropy alongside five Basic Glyphs, with nine million in raw complexity and purity to spare.
Her total accumulated power had already exceeded sixty million!
Yet she had not generated terrifying waves or grandiose eruptions because she possessed something that very few could even fathom.

At this moment, the Early Veiled Shore was entrenched at her core, positioned at the center of the Infiniverse Wheel itself. Its advancement and the continuing wonders that bloomed within its boundaries would affect her in ways that even Noah did not fully comprehend at this moment.
She was not merely advancing alongside the Shore; she was evolving in harmony with it, their development intertwined in ways where the effect was not fully known!
His mother, Henry, and others were steadily progressing past the ten million marker in Complexity as everyone advanced according to their own weavings and capabilities.
The shared benefits of his Ascendancy designation ensured that all members of his inner circle experienced growth that would have been impossible under normal circumstances!
As for himself...Noah’s entire visage carried an air of primal and archaic power that made the surrounding air shimmer.

His skin and muscles pulsed with heavy glows of brilliance! The combination of Sacred Mead of Existence consumption and the exponential acceleration provided by the Refined Glyph of Tyranny had created progression rates that surpassed even True Severed Adaptive Power of Existence.

His tyrannical monologues had not been mere displays that were useless- they had served as catalysts for the Glyph of Tyranny, accelerating his advancement through authentic expression of his fundamental nature, and truly...it felt good to talk down to hypocritical beings every now and then!
Through additional Ascendancy Marks of Existence, he had successfully forged more than fifty additional First Stage Towers of Osmont.
Combined with his three Refined Glyphs and twenty Basic Glyphs, plus the complexity and purity gained from tower construction itself, he now held 47 million in both CQ and PQ.
When he considered all factors together... he was already approaching the peak of Originus Venerant!
Oh!
Already!
Had it even already hit one full day since he attained the Early Veiled Shore?!
The speed of his advancement defied every normal expectation, compressed into timeframes that should have been impossible yet had become reality through the wonders of the Early Veiled Shore.
It was a moment that required profound silence and contemplation.
All of this terrifying progression had been made possible by the Early Veiled Shore and the unique opportunities it provided!
As Noah reflected upon these accomplishments, a familiar presence silently appeared before him.
Heidrun stood with shining arrogant eyes that bore into his with the imperious expectation that had become her trademark.
She blinked once, as if asking what exactly he was doing when there were obviously more important matters demanding attention.
Her head nudged toward the vibrant plot of green-gold grasses, the Auric Vitae specimens they had planted with such care and ceremony.
Above the cultivation area, a glorious archaic aurora of light swirled in a crescendo of power that spoke to processes reaching their ordained completion!
New information began flowing across Noah’s consciousness soon after.
|The Auric Vitae Grasses have reached full maturity and are ready for harvesting. Optimal harvesting window has begun.|

|Harvest Yield: Current mature grasses will yield 300% of originally planted amount due to Early Veiled Shore enhancement effects. Total harvestable material: 2,700 individual shoots of varying potency grades.|
|Seed Generation: Each harvested grass shoot will produce 3-5 viable seeds for replantation. Estimated total seed yield: 10,800 seeds capable of establishing new cultivation plots.|
Oh!

chapters.title: Chapter 3942: Oh! IV
paragraphs: Noah read prompt after prompt, and they did not even seem close to being done as more came even before one fully enjoyed the grandeur of the prompt before it!

|Replantation Process: Seeds may be planted immediately following harvest in prepared plots enhanced with Early Creature blood. Germination rate in Shore conditions: 98%. Time to maturity: 1 hour under current enhancement levels.|

|Plot Expansion: Additional cultivation areas may be established at any time through sacrifice of Early Creature blood. Recommended ratio: 18 drops per standard cultivation plot. Maximum sustainable plots limited only by available Shore territory.|

|Sacred Storage: Harvested crops may be stored within Sacred Totems, which will further enhance their weavings of existence for as long as they remain in containment. Enhancement rate: 5% potency increase per day of storage, maximum enhancement: 500%.|

|Quality Grading: Harvested materials will be automatically categorized into Standard, Superior, and Pristine grades based on Shore influence during growth. Higher grades provide exponentially greater benefits when consumed.|

|Processing Options: Raw consumption provides immediate but temporary benefits. Processed materials may be refined through Sacred Totem exposure, Early Creature alteration through cooking, or combination with other Early Sacred materials for permanent enhancement effects.|

|Manual Harvesting Required: Manual harvesting can be done by an Early Creature, an Early Living Land Lifeform, or Arch Living Existence to maintain optimal potency. Automated harvesting is possible through thr sacrifice of one drop of Blood, but it reduces effectiveness by 75%.|
Oh!
Noah smiled at the comprehensive information provided by the Shore’s systems, each prompt revealing new layers of complexity to what had initially seemed like simple agricultural work.

He rose from his seated position and reached out to stroke the lustrous coat of the arrogant Heidrun, her fur carrying warmth that seemed to be burning brighter as she looked at thr vibrant green gold grasses!

His gaze shifted toward Moiraine, whose transformation into a terrifying Honored Arch Living Existence wielding hundreds of Eminent Glyphs represented one of the most significant achievements so far. Yet...her first action after ascending to such overwhelming power would be to help manually harvest crops in the Early Veiled Shore!
There was something profoundly appropriate about this!
As Noah approached the cultivation plot with Heidrun beside him and Moiraine moving to join them, the Early Veiled Shore itself seemed to pulse with anticipation.
As he moved and began to harvest the grass by hand, he looked around and wondered...nothing too crazy was going on out there in the meanwhile, right?
Such a thought only rose once before he shook his head with a smile and returned to his task of harvesting.
Acting as an Early Creature- as a Farmer in this Early Veiled Shore had granted him a more rapid progression than what any grand battles or war would have.
Doing things in the Early Veiled Shore would actually allow him to progress the fastest!
The harvest began with quintessential glory.
Noah positioned himself at one edge of the cultivation plot while Moiraine approached from another angle, her newly transformed presence making the very air shimmer with contained authority.
Between them, Heidrun stood with the imperious confidence of someone who had never failed at any task she deemed worthy of her attention.
Glass containers materialized around the edges of the plot, their crystalline surfaces designed to preserve the unique properties of whatever they contained.
For her first attempt at harvesting, Heidrun approached a particularly vibrant cluster of green-gold shoots with the focused intensity of someone proving a point.
Her jaws opened with careful precision as she grasped the grass with movements that should have been flawless in their execution.
But...by the time her mouth moved toward the designated container, the Auric Vitae Grass had long since disappeared down her throat!
Oh!
Her eyes shone with pleasure and contentment that she couldn’t quite suppress, the taste of the delicacy overwhelming her intentions with pure sensory bliss.
Yet almost immediately, guilt flickered across her crystalline gaze as she realized what had occurred.
She looked toward Noah with an expression that mixed embarrassment with determination, noting how he remained focused on his own harvesting work without judgment or criticism.
In that moment, Heidrun made a decisive promise to herself: she would successfully harvest a bundle without consuming it.
Her second attempt began with even greater resolve.
She approached another cluster with movements that carried the dignity of someone who had learned from previous mistakes.
Her jaws closed around the grass with deliberate control, every fiber of her being focused on the simple task of transportation.
But once again, by the time her mouth reached the container, the grass had vanished into her stomach!
She released a tremendous sigh of contentment that spoke to satisfaction beyond conscious control, her body betraying her intentions through pure instinctive response to the incredible delicacy.
But this...
How could she fail at such a fundamental task? Her! An Eminent Early Living Land Lifeform whose capabilities should have transcended such simple difficulties!
She could do this. She would do this!
And so she continued to try, each attempt ending in the same inevitable conclusion despite her growing determination to succeed at what should have been elementary work.

Noah, meanwhile, had fully immersed himself in the harvest with the focused attention. He moved with unhurried precision, his hands working the blessed soil while his mind contemplated the larger implications of what they were accomplishing.
As he worked, his thoughts turned to the limitations that currently constrained the Early Veiled Shore.
Those boundaries had served their purpose during the initial development phase, but now they represented obstacles to greater achievement.
The Shore possessed infinite potential that remained locked behind arbitrary restrictions!

His eyes began to shine with growing intensity as understanding formed into decision. The time had come to push beyond current boundaries, to attempt advancement that would elevate the Shore to new heights!
As his hands continued their careful work, new information began flowing across his consciousness.

|Harvest Quality Assessment: Current collection consists entirely of Standard Quality Auric Vitae Grass. Environmental factors and harvesting technique have maintained baseline potency without enhancement or degradation.|
The assessment continued as both he and Moiraine worked with methodical precision, their combined efforts gradually filling container after container with the precious green-gold vegetation.

After helping to harvest more than half of the available crop, Noah nodded with satisfaction at their progress. He turned to Moiraine, whose delicate yet serious approach to the work showed how seriously she took it.
"Finish up," he said with quiet authority, his gaze shifting toward Heidrun, who had completely failed in all her attempts at harvesting.

The goat now lay upon the golden sands with a noticeably enlarged belly, her normally arrogant expression transformed into something that resembled drunken contentment from consuming hundreds of the precious grass shoots.
Noah shook his head with amusement at the sight before turning his attention to more pressing matters. His gaze swept across the radiant expanse of the Shore as he voiced his next intention!
"I shall sacrifice more blood to expand the number of cultivation plots- 5 more."
HUUM!
New prompts appeared soon after!
|Five new cultivation areas require 90 drops of Early Creature blood for proper enhancement and soil preparation. Enhanced plots will provide increased yield compared to original specifications.|
Noah nodded his agreement without hesitation!

His palm split open with the practiced ease of someone who had grown accustomed to such sacrifices, and ninety dull crimson-gold drops flowed forth like liquid starlight. They moved with purposeful intent toward empty areas of the Shore, each drop carrying within its essence the concentrated power needed to transform golden sands into blessed agricultural territory.
The blood sank into the golden sands, and immediately the transformation began.
Five additional plots of fertile land rose from the Shore itself, their surfaces shining with the same white-gold radiance that marked areas touched by Early Creature essence.
Satisfied with this expansion, Noah turned back to Moiraine, who continued her delicate work with the serious concentration of someone who understood the importance of precision in all things.
"When you are done harvesting," he instructed, "you can begin planting the seeds here and on the other plots."
Moiraine, this terrifying being whose power now ranked among Honored Arch Living Existences, simply nodded with the respectful attention of a devoted follower.
"Yes, Sir!" she replied without the slightest trace of resentment at being assigned such humble work, even looking at it as something sacred!
Noah’s expression grew more serious as he surveyed the Shore that had become his sanctuary and foundation for advancement beyond normal limitations.
When he spoke again, his words were tyrannically heavy.
"I wish...to fulfill the final condition for the advancement of the Early Veiled Shore."
Oh!

An Eminent Early Living Land Lifeform whose capabilities should have transcended such simple difficulties!
She could do this.
She would do this!
And so she continued to try, each attempt ending in the same inevitable conclusion despite her growing determination to succeed at what should have been elementary work.
Noah, meanwhile, had fully immersed himself in the harvest with the focused attention.
He moved with unhurried precision, his hands working the blessed soil while his mind contemplated the larger implications of what they were accomplishing.
As he worked, his thoughts turned to the limitations that currently constrained the Early Veiled Shore.
Those boundaries had served their purpose during the initial development phase, but now they represented obstacles to greater achievement.
The Shore possessed infinite potential that remained locked behind arbitrary restrictions!
His eyes began to shine with growing intensity as understanding formed into decision.
The time had come to push beyond current boundaries, to attempt advancement that would elevate the Shore to new heights!
As his hands continued their careful work, new information began flowing across his consciousness.
|Harvest Quality Assessment: Current collection consists entirely of Standard Quality Auric Vitae Grass.
Environmental factors and harvesting technique have maintained baseline potency without enhancement or degradation.|
The assessment continued as both he and Moiraine worked with methodical precision, their combined efforts gradually filling container after container with the precious green-gold vegetation.
After helping to harvest more than half of the available crop, Noah nodded with satisfaction at their progress.
He turned to Moiraine, whose delicate yet serious approach to the work showed how seriously she took it.
"Finish up," he said with quiet authority, his gaze shifting toward Heidrun, who had completely failed in all her attempts at harvesting.

The goat now lay upon the golden sands with a noticeably enlarged belly, her normally arrogant expression transformed into something that resembled drunken contentment from consuming hundreds of the precious grass shoots.
Noah shook his head with amusement at the sight before turning his attention to more pressing matters.
His gaze swept across the radiant expanse of the Shore as he voiced his next intention!
"I shall sacrifice more blood to expand the number of cultivation plots- 5 more."
HUUM!
New prompts appeared soon after!
|Five new cultivation areas require 90 drops of Early Creature blood for proper enhancement and soil preparation.
Enhanced plots will provide increased yield compared to original specifications.|
Noah nodded his agreement without hesitation!
His palm split open with the practiced ease of someone who had grown accustomed to such sacrifices, and ninety dull crimson-gold drops flowed forth like liquid starlight.
They moved with purposeful intent toward empty areas of the Shore, each drop carrying within its essence the concentrated power needed to transform golden sands into blessed agricultural territory.
The blood sank into the golden sands, and immediately the transformation began.
Five additional plots of fertile land rose from the Shore itself, their surfaces shining with the same white-gold radiance that marked areas touched by Early Creature essence.
Satisfied with this expansion, Noah turned back to Moiraine, who continued her delicate work with the serious concentration of someone who understood the importance of precision in all things.
"When you are done harvesting," he instructed, "you can begin planting the seeds here and on the other plots."
Moiraine, this terrifying being whose power now ranked among Honored Arch Living Existences, simply nodded with the respectful attention of a devoted follower.
"Yes, Sir!" she replied without the slightest trace of resentment at being assigned such humble work, even looking at it as something sacred!
Noah’s expression grew more serious as he surveyed the Shore that had become his sanctuary and foundation for advancement beyond normal limitations.
When he spoke again, his words were tyrannically heavy.
"I wish...to fulfill the final condition for the advancement of the Early Veiled Shore."
Oh!

chapters.title: Chapter 3943: Oh! V
paragraphs: The Shore had served them well in its current Budding state, but the limitations imposed by this initial phase had begun to constrain their potential for growth.
Too many restrictions remained in place, preventing them from accessing capabilities that lay just beyond their current reach.
He had Sacred Totems, but he could not call anymore Early Living Land Lifeforms!
He needed more plots of land to grow more and different Sacred Herbs.
He needed many things that the current level of the Early Veiled Shore was limited by.
He needed to advance to the Blooming Shore, regardless of the risks such transformation might entail!
The moment he voiced this intention, radiant archaic light began flowing around the entire Early Veiled Shore like aurora made manifest.
The very air seemed to thicken with anticipation as ancient weavings recognized the significance of what was being attempted!
HUUM!
New information cascaded across his consciousness.
|The final condition for Budding Shore advancement to Blooming Shore status is being challenged. Initiating trial protocols that have remained dormant for an unknown number of years.|
|Shore Memory Gate manifestation imminent. Transference across multiple weavings of existence will commence, targeting a distant Lost Basic Record of an Early Creature.|

|Trial Designation: You will be assigned a random Record Body of an Early Living Marine Lifeform that closely matches your current level of power, with your power, complexity, glyphs...being carried over in addition to whatever power the Marine Lifeform holds. Success requires survival of the full encounter with the Early Creature present in the Lost Basic Record. Failure results in permanent termination of advancement potential.|

|Due to the extremely low probability of success, limited aid is permitted. Three summons of Early Living Land Lifeforms or other Lifeforms from the Early Veiled Shore are authorized, each manifestation lasting exactly five seconds before forced return.|

|Early Creature Record Threat Assessment- The Early Creature in this trial operates according to complete authenticity parameters. No limitations have been imposed on its capabilities. Survival probability approaches zero even for beings of Honored status. Simple endurance from luck and other factors represents the absolute limit of possible achievement.|
|Trial Duration: Objective survival time set at one minute.|
Oh!
Oh goodness!

Noah reviewed the prompts with growing seriousness, understanding that what he was about to attempt represented a trial designed to test beings whose power dwarfed even the mightiest Living Existences.
Yet the potential rewards justified any risk, promising advancement that could elevate the Shore beyond all current limitations!
In a portion of the Early Veiled Shore, the golden sands began rising to form an archway that pulsed with its own inner radiance.
The Shore Memory Gate took shape with geometric precision that hurt to observe directly, its surface reflecting memories of events that had shaped the weavings of existence of distant possibilities.
Noah cast one final glance at his companions.
Moiraine continued her harvesting work with methodical precision, while Heidrun remained sprawled upon the sands with her expression of drunken satisfaction.
In the distance, others maintained their meditative positions, their advancement continuing through the passive benefits of the Shore’s unique environment.
"Hoo..." He breathed out and himself ready.
Without further hesitation, Noah walked toward the Shore Memory Gate and...disappeared into its radiant embrace!
The sensation of traversal was unique.

He felt himself moving across records so massive and fundamental that they dwarfed the accumulated knowledge of entire Folds, their weight pressing against his consciousness like the attention of unknown creatures!
These were memories that could cause even Living Existences to question their significance in the grand scheme of existence.
And after what felt like eons compressed into seconds, blinding blue light began to flash around him as new information flooded his awareness.
|Arrival confirmed at the Blooming Shore of Early Creature designated Thal’dorven the Primordial Fisher. Current location: Early Sacred Waters at depth of 400 fathoms.|

|Record Body Assignment: Refined Early Living Marine Lifeform - Designation: Prismatic Tide Serpent. Current capabilities include enhanced mobility, water manipulation, and moderate defensive adaptations.|

|Early Creature Thal’dorven the Primordial Fisher will begin harvesting activities within the next 30 seconds. Survival objective: Endure presence and activities for one minute duration. No additional objectives required.|
Oh!
The Early Sacred Waters around him shimmered with authority so concentrated it made his borrowed body vibrate!
Dozens of other gorgeous and gloriously powerful Refined Early Living Marine Lifeforms swam in careful formations around him, their movements speaking to intelligence.

But despite their beauty and obvious power, all of them carried expressions of deep apprehension, as if they understood with perfect clarity that they would soon become ingredients for something far greater than themselves.
At their head swam a being that commanded attention through sheer presence alone.
An Eminent Early Living Marine Lifeform!
The Eminent Early Living Marine Lifeform resembled an anglerfish, but elevated to proportions and beauty that defied normal categories.
Its bioluminescent lure pulsed with patterns that spoke to deep-sea mysteries older than recorded history, while its form combined predatory grace with otherworldly elegance.

An Eminent Early Living Existential Glyph of Water blazed upon its sleek hide, surrounded by hundreds of Refined Glyphs of Water that created patterns of power visible even in the depths of these sacred waters.

When it opened its magnificent jaws to release a roar that sent reverberations across the aquatic realm, the sound carried challenge and defiance directed toward an Early Creature they could not yet perceive.
Noah wanted to smack it right away.
Why the hell was it trying to die so quickly, he just needed a minute!
The moment that roar echoed through the depths, reality itself seemed to pause in recognition of what was about to unfold.
Then came the response that would test every assumption Noah held about the nature of power and survival.
An utterly terrifying aura bloomed and swept over everything with the inexorable force of judgment!

Just from this preliminary manifestation of presence, Noah felt five of his Basic Glyphs buzz and dim as if they were being shattered by the sheer weight of attention from something that existed beyond normal categories of existence.
Two Marine Lifeform had their bodies buzz as they went limp.
From...an aura alone.
Oh!
This 1 minute survival...was about to feel like eons, and that was if he survived the next few seconds!
Oh!!!

chapters.title: Chapter 3944: Brutal! I
paragraphs: A day could feel like passing seconds when immersed in the flow of meaningful work, yet a second could sometimes stretch into eons when faced with the prospect of imminent annihilation.

When confronted with an utterly terrifying force that existed beyond all normal categories of power, surviving a single minute seemed not merely difficult but fundamentally impossible, as if Existence itself had decreed that certain thresholds should never be crossed by lesser beings!
The aura of the Early Creature swept outward like a tide of compressed authority, carrying with it the weight of existence itself distilled into pure presence.

In the next moment, Noah felt his entire being freeze as comprehension dawned with horrifying clarity! From above, descending through the Early Sacred Waters with inexorable purpose, came what appeared to be a spear.
But as the object drew closer, its true nature became apparent.

This was no weapon of war, but something far more mundane and yet infinitely more terrifying in its implications. The thin implement carried a hook at its end that seemed to exert magnetic attraction on the very essence of existence itself, seeking to impale consciousness and drag it upward like the most common of catches.
It was a fishing hook.
A fishing hook!
Simple, utilitarian, and absolutely unstoppable in its descent toward the assembled Marine Lifeforms.
Noah watched in horrified fascination as the hook descended through the crystalline waters, its presence causing reality itself to bend around its path.
All around him, the Refined Early Living Marine Lifeforms froze as if time itself had stopped flowing through their bodies!
Only the magnificent Eminent creature that led them retained the ability to move, its superior nature allowing it to struggle against forces that rendered lesser beings helpless as caught fish.
But even the Eminent being’s resistance proved futile. The hook wove through the waters with casual precision, its path predetermined by intelligence.
It pierced through three of the Refined Marine Lifeforms with the ease of a needle passing through silk, then sprang upward with its harvest secured upon the barbed point.

Noah’s eyes buzzed with seriousness as he witnessed Refined Early Living Marine Lifeforms, beings whose power exceeded that of many Originus Venerant entities whose complexity ranged between ten and twenty million in both quotients, plucked from their element like goldfish caught by a child’s first fishing rod!
The casual nature of their capture spoke to power disparities so vast that normal categories of measurement became meaningless!
Within his borrowed body, the Refined Glyphs and Towers of Osmont that defined his accumulated strength began to resonate with alarm.
He could not even move when the fishing line descended, his existence locked in place by forces that recognized no resistance. A force that overcame his 1002% collective Resistances!
The only reason he had survived this initial harvest was pure chance, the random fortune that had placed him outside the hook’s predetermined path.
The difficulty of this Record was beyond anything he had imagined.

Even Honored Living Existences might struggle against the Early Creature whose casual fishing expedition could erase beings of tremendous power with no more effort than gathering ingredients for an evening meal!
At this moment of paralyzing realization, the fearsome Eminent Early Living Marine Lifeform released a roar that sent shockwaves through the sacred waters.
Its magnificent voice carried rage and defiance as it witnessed its companions being harvested like common livestock, the sound echoing wit weavings that spoke to fury!
The creature began rising toward the surface, its powerful form cutting through the water with movements that defied the crushing pressure of the Early Creature’s presence.
Behind it, the remaining Marine Lifeforms followed with the desperate urgency of beings who understood they were swimming toward their doom yet had no alternative.
Noah’s initial instinct was to remain hidden in the depths, to avoid drawing attention that could only result in his immediate destruction.
The logical choice was to let the others face whatever horror awaited above while he sought shelter in the darkest corners of these sacred waters.
But the moment this thought formed in his consciousness, his existence began buzzing with the unmistakable sensation of enormous danger approaching.
His enhanced intuition, honed through countless trials and elevated by the gifts of the Early Veiled Shore, screamed a warning that isolation would mean death.
If he remained behind while the others ascended, he would be hunted down and eliminated with even greater ease than those who had already been caught.

This was a terrifying realization that he trusted without question. He began rising alongside the other Marine Lifeforms, his borrowed body moving with reluctant urgency toward whatever awaited them at the surface!

As they emerged from the Early Sacred Waters, Noah’s enhanced perception took in everything he could observe in a single comprehensive sweep, as if time itself had frozen to allow him to catalog the impossible wonders that stretched before them.
First and most shocking of all, he saw the Early Creature itself.
Thal’dorven the Primordial Fisher!
He sat upon a sand dune with the casual posture of someone engaged in the most routine of activities.
The being’s appearance was simultaneously humanoid and utterly alien, ancient beyond measure yet carrying the vital presence of something that had never known decay or diminishment.
Its upper body was laid bare, revealing skin of burnished bronze that seemed to contain within its surface the accumulated light of countless suns!
Every muscle was gloriously defined and sculpted according to principles of perfection that transcended normal physical development.

The Early Creature’s lower body was covered by what appeared to be an animal skin skirt, yet even this simple garment shone with multicolored light that suggested construction from materials harvested from Eminent or Kleos Early Living Lifeforms!
The casual display of such precious materials as common clothing spoke to resources and capabilities that dwarfed anything Noah had previously encountered.
It showed the wonder and absolute mystery surrounding Early Creatures!
What truly captured his attention, however, was the expression of absolute calm and apathy that marked the Early Creature’s features as it attended to its fishing rod!

chapters.title: Chapter 3945: Brutal! II
paragraphs: With movements that carried no more emotional weight than preparing a simple meal, Thal’dorven removed the Marine Lifeforms caught upon his hook, using hands that moved with casual precision to snap their necks before tossing the bodies into a bucket placed conveniently beside him.
The sight was simultaneously mundane and horrifying, speaking to a perspective that viewed beings of tremendous power as nothing more than ingredients for dinner.
Did Noah...not look at Basic Early Living Marine Lifeforms just like this?
As his gaze swept beyond the Early Creature, Noah began to observe the fantastical layout of this Blooming Shore that served as Thal’dorven’s domain.

The realm stretched across horizons that seemed to exist beyond normal spatial limitations, each area dedicated to different aspects of cultivation and development that made his own Shore seem primitive by comparison.
Vast plots filled with radiant Sacred Herbs created patterns across the landscape, their arrangement suggesting knowledge accumulated over eons of experimentation and refinement.
Each plant pulsed with its own inner radiance!
Massive and complex Sacred Totems rose from strategic positions throughout the Shore, their bells towering five times higher than anything Noah had managed to construct.

The structures hummed with authority so concentrated it was visible as distortions in the surrounding air, their presence suggesting capabilities that transcended his current understanding of what such monuments could accomplish.
Groves of trees bearing vibrant fruits created areas of concentrated life that made the very atmosphere shimmer with barely contained vitality.

Each piece of fruit appeared to contain within its flesh the compressed essence of advancement itself, promising transformations that could elevate any being fortunate enough to partake of their bounty!
Throughout this impossible garden moved five unique Early Living Land Lifeforms, their presence adding layers of complexity to an already overwhelming display of accumulated resources.
Four appeared to be of Refined status, while the fifth was clearly Eminent, its size alone dwarfing anything he had previously encountered.

The Eminent Land Lifeform resembled a crystalline stag whose antlers branched into patterns that burned to observe directly, each point containing compressed Folds that pulsed with their own weavings!
Its mere presence seemed to stabilize the Shore itself, suggesting symbiotic relationships between Early Creatures and their chosen companions.
Additional features dotted the landscape with the kind of primitive grandeur that spoke to an entity that had achieved perfection through simplicity rather than complexity.
After absorbing this impossible wonder in what felt like both an instant and an epoch, Noah’s attention snapped back to more immediate concerns as he noticed the timer for his survival trial.
Forty-five seconds remained.
The countdown felt simultaneously too long and impossibly brief, each passing moment bringing him closer to either triumph or absolute annihilation!

He looked ahead as the Marine Lifeforms around him began roaring their defiance, their voices combining into a chorus of challenge directed toward the Early Creature who had dared to treat them as mere prey.
Their combined might created waves of authority that would have impressed even Honored Living Existences, yet their display seemed to have no more effect than children shouting at a mountain!
Children trying to topple an elephant!
Thal’dorven looked up at them with what might have been amusement, his expression shifting from casual indifference to something approaching mild interest.
When he smiled, the expression carried the weight of Existence aligning themselves according to his will.
In the next moment, a single Glyph appeared upon his forehead with the brilliance of a Wheel being born.
The symbol blazed with the authority of Living Law itself, its presence transforming the fundamental nature of reality in the immediate area!
The moment the Glyph manifested, a massive white hand descended from the skies above with the inexorable certainty of gravity itself.
The appendage was composed of pure Living Law given form, its fingers spread wide to encompass half of the remaining Marine Lifeforms in a grip that wanted no resistance!

Noah felt his existence freeze once again as the hand approached, but this time his paralysis was not complete. The combined effects of his accumulated power and the desperate urgency of the situation allowed him to retain just enough mobility to act, though every second of delay brought the descending hand closer to sealing his fate.
The moment those massive fingers closed around him, he would be crushed out of existence with no more ceremony than swatting an insect.
He knew this!
He understood this with absolute certainty, the knowledge burning through his consciousness like acid through flesh!
Gritting his teeth against the overwhelming pressure that sought to reduce him to helpless prey, Noah’s mind buzzed with command!
|Summon the Lifeform Moiraine!|
BOOM!
In the next instant, the space around his Marine Lifeform body buzzed with the arrival of something glorious!

The illusory yet tangible form of Moiraine materialized beside him, her nine winged halos and five hundred Eminent Glyphs blazing with authority that momentarily challenged even the oppressive presence of the Early Creature.
She was shocked as she took in their surroundings, her enhanced perception immediately observing the impossible nature of their situation!
But the connection between her consciousness and Noah’s allowed her to understand the critical nature of their circumstances without need for lengthy explanation.
His voice reached her through the chaos of clashing authorities, carrying the urgency of someone whose existence hung by the thinnest of threads!
|Keep us alive for the next five seconds!|
WAA!
Her existence erupted with power as understanding crystallized into action. Without hesitation, without calculation of odds or consideration of personal safety, she roared her acknowledgment.
"Yes, Sir!"
Valiant.
Glorious.
For him...she would give anything!
Every one of her five hundred Eminent Glyphs blazed with simultaneous brilliance as she channeled the full extent of her accumulated power against the white hand descending upon them!
The collision of forces that followed would determine whether Noah’s trial continued or ended in the crushing grip of a terrifying authority made manifest.
And with the power of an Early Creature, it was truly hard to say just how the scales would tip!

The Eminent Land Lifeform resembled a crystalline stag whose antlers branched into patterns that burned to observe directly, each point containing compressed Folds that pulsed with their own weavings!
Its mere presence seemed to stabilize the Shore itself, suggesting symbiotic relationships between Early Creatures and their chosen companions.
Additional features dotted the landscape with the kind of primitive grandeur that spoke to an entity that had achieved perfection through simplicity rather than complexity.
After absorbing this impossible wonder in what felt like both an instant and an epoch, Noah’s attention snapped back to more immediate concerns as he noticed the timer for his survival trial.
Forty-five seconds remained.
The countdown felt simultaneously too long and impossibly brief, each passing moment bringing him closer to either triumph or absolute annihilation!

He looked ahead as the Marine Lifeforms around him began roaring their defiance, their voices combining into a chorus of challenge directed toward the Early Creature who had dared to treat them as mere prey.
Their combined might created waves of authority that would have impressed even Honored Living Existences, yet their display seemed to have no more effect than children shouting at a mountain!
Children trying to topple an elephant!
Thal’dorven looked up at them with what might have been amusement, his expression shifting from casual indifference to something approaching mild interest.
When he smiled, the expression carried the weight of Existence aligning themselves according to his will.
In the next moment, a single Glyph appeared upon his forehead with the brilliance of a Wheel being born.
The symbol blazed with the authority of Living Law itself, its presence transforming the fundamental nature of reality in the immediate area!
The moment the Glyph manifested, a massive white hand descended from the skies above with the inexorable certainty of gravity itself.
The appendage was composed of pure Living Law given form, its fingers spread wide to encompass half of the remaining Marine Lifeforms in a grip that wanted no resistance!
Noah felt his existence freeze once again as the hand approached, but this time his paralysis was not complete.

The combined effects of his accumulated power and the desperate urgency of the situation allowed him to retain just enough mobility to act, though every second of delay brought the descending hand closer to sealing his fate.
The moment those massive fingers closed around him, he would be crushed out of existence with no more ceremony than swatting an insect.
He knew this!
He understood this with absolute certainty, the knowledge burning through his consciousness like acid through flesh!
Gritting his teeth against the overwhelming pressure that sought to reduce him to helpless prey, Noah’s mind buzzed with command!
|Summon the Lifeform Moiraine!|
BOOM!
In the next instant, the space around his Marine Lifeform body buzzed with the arrival of something glorious!

The illusory yet tangible form of Moiraine materialized beside him, her nine winged halos and five hundred Eminent Glyphs blazing with authority that momentarily challenged even the oppressive presence of the Early Creature.
She was shocked as she took in their surroundings, her enhanced perception immediately observing the impossible nature of their situation!
But the connection between her consciousness and Noah’s allowed her to understand the critical nature of their circumstances without need for lengthy explanation.
His voice reached her through the chaos of clashing authorities, carrying the urgency of someone whose existence hung by the thinnest of threads!
|Keep us alive for the next five seconds!|
WAA!
Her existence erupted with power as understanding crystallized into action.
Without hesitation, without calculation of odds or consideration of personal safety, she roared her acknowledgment.
"Yes, Sir!"
Valiant.
Glorious.
For him...she would give anything!
Every one of her five hundred Eminent Glyphs blazed with simultaneous brilliance as she channeled the full extent of her accumulated power against the white hand descending upon them!
The collision of forces that followed would determine whether Noah’s trial continued or ended in the crushing grip of a terrifying authority made manifest.
And with the power of an Early Creature, it was truly hard to say just how the scales would tip!

chapters.title: Chapter 3946: Brutal! III
paragraphs: At the explosive outburst of Moiraine’s power, reality itself seemed to bend around the collision of forces.
Her five hundred Eminent Glyphs of Paradox blazed with such concentrated authority that the very fabric of existence groaned under the strain of containing such tremendous energy!
The white hand, descending with the inexorable certainty of existential evolution judgment, shockingly deviated slightly in its descent.
For a breathless moment that stretched across eons, the massive appendage of Law trembled as it encountered a deviation of resistance it had not expected to find!

Moiraine’s accumulated power, refined through processes that had elevated her beyond a normal Living Existence, created a deviation that even the Early Creature’s casual authority could not immediately penetrate!
Yet the pause was brief. The white hand completed its descent, managing to grasp half of the remaining Marine Lifeforms in its crushing grip, but Noah found himself excluded from its harvest.
Moiraine’s intervention had been sufficient to deflect the targeting, though at tremendous cost to her own reserves of power.
On the shore, Thal’dorven the Primordial Fisher looked genuinely surprised for the first time since the trial began.
His expression shifted from casual indifference to interest as he observed the unexpected resistance to his authority.
At this moment of reprieve, the surviving Marine Lifeforms launched their desperate retaliation!
The magnificent Eminent creature that led them roared with renewed fury as it directed the others in a coordinated assault against the Early Creature who had dared to treat them as mere prey.
Their combined might created waves of authority that would have impressed even Royal Living Existences, yet their display seemed to barely register on Thal’dorven’s consciousness!

Moiraine materialized more solidly beside Noah, her form radiating protective determination as she positioned herself between him and any further threats. Her nine winged halos spun with increasing velocity while her Glyphs prepared for whatever horrors might come next.
And yet, as their desperate resistance unfolded, a voice boomed across the battlefield with such exotic power that reality itself seemed to reshape around its utterances.

"That is not the power of a little fish at the Refined level or even simple Eminent level. And was that Paradox? Haha, are one of my lesser brethren attempting a shore advancement right now? You should not have allowed me to know!"
Oh?
Oh!
The voice of the Early Creature carried weight!
Heavy weight!
Each syllable resonated through dimensions, while undertones suggested depths of experience.
The sound was simultaneously beautiful and terrifying, like hearing the voice of existence itself speaking with casual amusement about the struggles of insects.
The exotic power contained within those words caused all the Marine Lifeforms, including Noah and Moiraine, to freeze as understanding dawned with horrifying clarity.
They were fucked!
Instantly, with movement that transcended normal concepts of speed, Thal’dorven appeared in front of the most powerful Eminent Marine Lifeform.
The creature that had led their desperate charge now found itself face to face with something that existed beyond all resistance.
The Early Creature tapped out with casual precision, a single finger making contact with the Eminent being’s magnificent form.
The result...was immediate and absolute.
The Marine Lifeform collapsed and began unraveling into streams of light, its accumulated power dissipating like smoke before wind as its very existence was casually negated!
Simply.
Calmly.
Horrifically!

Thal’dorven smiled with dangerous satisfaction as his gaze swept across the remaining fish, his expression carrying the particular joy of someone who had just discovered an unexpected source of entertainment.

"Do you know that if the attempt of advancement fails from my actions, I actually get a boon from it? Now that I know, I will naturally get serious and not allow you to pass! Haha, how much time do you have left? It won’t matter as I won’t let this go for even another second. I will just wipe the rest of these weak fishes out!"
Noah’s expression became unfathomably heavy as the full implications of their situation crystallized with devastating clarity.
At such a moment of absolute despair, Moiraine’s voice rang out with desperate defiance!
"YAA!"
She had two seconds remaining in her manifestation, but her eyes blazed with fierce determination as she shot forward.
She understood that her Sir was attempting something grand here, something that could reshape the very foundations of his power!
The casual joy this being took in causing his failure ignited fury within her!
She would not allow this.
Seas of golden Paradox began gathering around her form as she prepared to expend everything in a final desperate gambit.
Her accumulated power condensed into patterns of glory, wonders of a myraid weavings of Paradoxes forming!
Yet the expression on the Early Creature’s face remained placid, almost bored, as he observed her gathering might.
Above his head, with the casual ease of someone swatting an annoying insect, another Glyph appeared.
PAH!
The symbol flashed with brilliance that hurt to perceive directly, and Noah’s enhanced vision identified it with growing horror.
This was not merely an Eminent or Refined Glyph.
It was...
A Kleos Early Living Existential Glyph of Law!
Kleos!
It instantly erased Moiraine into dust, her accumulated power and tremendous advancement reduced to scattered particles that drifted away on calm winds.
Her short journey in this record came to an end as she was sent back!
The casual ease with which she was destroyed spoke to power disparities that rendered all resistance meaningless.
|The Arch Living Existence, Moiraine, has been forcefully laid to rest from this Record. Her manifestation has been terminated through absolute authority.|
The prompt that appeared carried finality that stated no argument or hope of reversal!

One of his greatest achievements, the being he had elevated beyond defined categories through careful application of gifts had been casually obliterated by forces that recognized no limit to their dominion.
The eyes of the Early Creature remained calm and apathetic as his Glyph prepared to flash again, its target now clearly focused upon Noah himself!
There would be no reprieve, no moment of hesitation, no opportunity for desperate last stands!
Yet at this moment of absolute certainty, Noah stepped forward with tyrannical fearlessness that defied every rational calculation.
He could fail.
The possibility hung before him like an executioner’s blade, carrying with it consequences that would echo across every aspect of his existence.
Failure would come with results so heavy they might crush his ambitions and his very essence.
Yet at this critical juncture, he did not call out for anyone else to manifest beside him.
When faced with the impossible, when confronted with forces that transcended every normal category of resistance, there were still ways to survive.
One such method was knowledge. And understanding how to wield it with precision!

chapters.title: Chapter 3947: The Weight of Obsession! I
paragraphs: In the moment before the Early Creature’s Glyph could flash with terminal authority, Noah spoke with calm certainty.
"You are a Record of yourself. You are already dead."
HUUM!
The words struck Thal’dorven with such unexpected force that his casual demeanor faltered.

The Early Creature stopped, his Living authority pausing as he focused his full attention upon this insignificant Marine Lifeform who had dared to speak truth that cut to his heart of existence itself!
In the next moment, Noah’s serpentine form began changing as his own glorious humanoid shape manifested.
His bare upper body emerged with the same primitive majesty that marked Thal’dorven, his skin gleaming with inner radiance while muscles spoke to power!
Power!
Noah stared coldly at the Early Creature as his understanding crystallized into strategy.
"Someone of your stature should be able to sense it," he said with calculating precision, each word chosen to cut through layers of self-deception that even Records could maintain.

"You are but an echo, a memory given form but no longer truly Living. The rewards you speak of gaining from my failure are illusions, phantoms of desires that belonged to the being you once were but can never be again."
His voice carried tyrannical authority as he continued!

"You possess no capacity to benefit from my success or failure. You are a shadow cast by light that no longer shines, a story told by voices that have long since fallen silent. Whatever obsessions drive you now are the chains of a dead past binding a present that should not exist."
HUUM!
The Early Creature’s expression shifted to something that combined majesty with profound despondence, of power mingled with existential sorrow!

"Of course," Thal’dorven replied, his voice carrying weavings of acceptance mixed with endless regret. "I know that I am dead. The knowledge burns through every moment of this false existence. But understanding changes nothing."

His gaze grew distant as he continued, "I still carry my obsessions, the fundamental patterns that defined who I was when life flowed through these veins. Obsession, you see, is one of the more terrifying tools anyone can possess. It transcends death, outlasts reason, persists when every logical foundation has crumbled away."
The Early Creature’s smile carried the weight of tragedy as he focused once more upon Noah.
"No, I do not have to kill you. But my obsession, who I was and who I remain even as a Record, will ensure that you are killed. Because some patterns run deeper than existence itself."
Noah nodded with calm understanding, recognizing the fundamental nature of what they faced.
Yet even as acceptance settled over him, curiosity burned with its own form of desperate intensity.
"Before you kill me then," he said with the measured tone of someone requesting a final favor, "could you tell me more about us? About why you died? And why others are nowhere to be seen?"
These words caused the Record of the Early Creature to have his eyes flash with genuine surprise, awareness focusing upon weavings that had not occurred to him until this moment!
"The others are missing?" Thal’dorven said, his voice carrying undertones of growing concern. "This..."
He seemed contemplative as understanding began to dawn, ancient mind processing information that challenged assumptions he had carried since his death!
Soon he shook his head with a smile that mixed sorrow with resigned determination.

"You have already utilized your one chance to call for help from your Land Lifeforms," he said, returning to the immediate situation. "And you would need to survive here for at least five minutes to elevate from Budding Shore to Blooming Shore. There is time enough for you to obtain information regarding what happened all those eons ago and connect it to whatever age this has become."
His expression hardened as obsession reasserted its dominion over curiosity!

"But again, my nature will not allow that. My personality was inherently selfish and self-serving, and even in death, obsession does not change. I will gain nothing from your success, yet my Record will feel satisfied in causing your failure."
The Early Creature’s smile turned cold as he voiced the fundamental cruelty that drove his actions!
"If I am dead, why should others prosper? What benefit do I gain from your advancement? The outlook is simple- I have nothing to gain from your success, everything to gain from your failure."
The philosophy was extremely cruel and self-serving, speaking to darkness that transcended malice!

As he spoke these words, the terrifying Kleos Glyph on his forehead flared with renewed intensity while thousands of other Glyphs materialized across his form, each one preparing to unleash forces that would end absolutely everything!
Noah shook his head with tyrannical certainty, his gaze carrying the weight of someone who had calculated possibilities beyond the immediate situation.
He had calculated much!
"I do not have only a single chance to call a Land Lifeform," he said with calm precision. "And the time I need to survive is significantly less than what you believe."
As he spoke, his eyes flicked upward to observe the timer that had been counting down since the trial began. Five seconds remained.
At this critical moment, brilliance flashed before him as a terrifying aura manifested with the force of existential intervention.
The resplendent white goat, Heidrun, appeared in front of Noah with such majesty that even the Early Creature paused in recognition of what he was witnessing.
Her lustrous coat blazed with inner radiance while her crystalline eyes carried determination that transcended her usual arrogance!
She positioned herself as if she would defend Noah against anything and everything, her stance speaking to loyalty that had been earned through simple kindness and respect.
After all, this man had fed her, had provided her with delicacies beyond imagination.
Even when she had failed repeatedly to harvest anything, he had not criticized or discouraged her efforts.
He was a good Early Creature!
She would save him if salvation was needed!
When Thal’dorven saw Heidrun, genuine shock crossed his features for the second time since the trial began.
His voice carried amazement that bordered on disbelief!
"How could you possibly have something like that with a mere Budding Shore?!"
Noah looked calmly at this being as the final seconds trickled away, his voice carrying the weight of absolute conviction.
"Because my obsession... is greater and more quintessential than yours."
With those words, as the timer reached its final moment...
BOOM!
Everything became painted in brilliant gold!
