chapters.title: Chapter 3948: The Weight of Obsession! II
paragraphs: Everything became painted in brilliant gold as Noah felt utterly complex radiance cover him from head to toe!
The sensation was simultaneously overwhelming and gentle.
Prompts began unfolding before his vision with the stately precision of recognition!

|You have successfully survived one minute before an Early Creature against all odds. This achievement transcends normal categories of possibility and marks you as worthy of advancement beyond current limitations.|
|All requirements to advance the Budding Shore to Blooming Shore status have been achieved. Initiation of transformation commencing immediately.|
The prompts came in unending wave as Noah felt both relief and weariness!
And they continued.
|Your Early Veiled Shore will now begin advancing and expanding according to parameters established during the earliest epochs of existence. Prepare for fundamental alteration of your domain.|
|Shore expansion multiplier is 500%. Total area increase from baseline specifications will reshape the nature of your Shore.|

|Early Living Land Lifeform capacity has been increased to twenty-five beings. Current occupancy: five slots are utilized by the existence of Heidrun alone, reflecting her exceptional nature and requirements.|

|Early Sacred Herb procurement now possible through utilization of Records obtained from the Blooming Shore of the Early Creature designated as Thal’dorven the Primordial Fisher. Requirements include the sacrifice of existing Sacred Herbs plus drops of Early Creature blood.|
|Trade network access may be established- Connection to Records of other Early Creature’s Shores allows for resource exchange and knowledge acquisition.|
The Prompts just continued coming relentlessly as the advancement of the shore came with utterly too many points!
And horrifically, it was not done.
Oh, it was not done!

|Early Folds Plot System Unlocked. Through the advancement to Blooming Shore status, you have gained access to the ancient practice of Early Fold Designation - a cultivation method that transcends normal agricultural limitations by creating living pocket dimensions specifically attuned to the growth of singular, incomparably precious Early Sacred Herbs.|

|You may designate up to nine (9) specialized Plots as Early Folds, each existing as a miniature living dimensional space anchored within your Blooming Shore. Each Early Fold can only cultivate one specific type of Unique Early Sacred Herb, but the herbs grown within these folds will possess potency and properties that exceed anything achievable through conventional methods.|

|Creating an Early Fold requires the sacrifice of 100 Drops of Early Creature Blood to establish the dimensional anchor, plus an additional 50 Drops to attune the fold to a specific herb type. The initial seed or sample of the desired Unique Early Sacred Herb must be provided during the designation process and will be consumed to establish the fold’s weaving of Existence.|

|Each Early Fold exists as a stable Living pocket dimension that cannot be detected or accessed by external forces, protected by the fundamental authority of the Early Creature who created it. The folds are immune to temporal manipulation, spatial interference, and existential disruption by beings below Early Creature status.|

|The most extraordinary capability of Unique Early Sacred Herbs lies in their ability to grant understanding of Lost Forgotten Principles - fundamental truths about existence that were known to the earliest beings but have since been erased from Existence itself. These principles transcend normal concepts of authority, law, or power, representing the foundational mechanics upon which all existence was originally constructed.|

|Example Lost Forgotten Principle: The Principle of Existential Primacy- The authority to declare oneself as the fundamental basis upon which other typed of existence depend on, making one’s continued existence a prerequisite for the continued existence of other things. Mastery of this principle rendered Early Creatures nigh impossible to kill by making their death equivalent to existential annihilation.|
|Current Status- 0/9 Early Folds designated. Designation process available immediately upon availability of required materials and selection of desired Unique Early Sacred Herb specimens.|
Sheesh!
Sheesh!!!
Noah had no words at the endless array of prompts.
This time, there were truly too many, and each was more profound than the other!
Noah felt the golden glow beginning to fade as the transformation completed its initial phase.
His consciousness descended back into his own Early Veiled Shore, the Memory Gate crumbling as its purpose was fulfilled.
His feet touched the familiar golden sands with the relief of someone returning home after journeying through a place of impossible danger.
Yet even as he sighed with the satisfaction of survival against insurmountable odds, his attention was immediately captured by changes occurring throughout his domain.
The edges of the mist that had always marked the boundaries of his Shore began churning with new energy, swirling patterns that spoke to expansion beyond previous limitations.
In the next moment, those boundaries exploded outward.
The Early Veiled Shore transformed before his eyes as it evolved from its Budding state into the full glory of a Blooming Shore!
The golden sands stretched in all directions, encompassing territory that dwarfed his previous domain.
Where once he had possessed a sanctuary of significant but limited scope, he now commanded a domain that approached the scale of proper Early Veiled Shore!
Six new radiant trees materialized to join the original three that had anchored his domain since its inception, their forms towering higher than before while their branches spread to create canopies.
Each tree pulsed with its own unique weaving of life-giving energy, their roots extending through dimensional space to create networks of connections!
The crystalline waters that had always marked one edge of his domain now expanded into a proper sea, its shores creating bays and inlets that suggested possibilities of even more wonders.
The water itself had grown denser with life.
Throughout the vastly expanded landscape, new features manifested with a kind of primitive grandeur!

Areas specifically designated for different forms of farming stretched across horizons. The plots where Auric Vitae Grass currently grew appeared insignificant compared to the possibilities now available.
Noah stood at the center of this transformed domain, taking in all the new features as he went over the lengthy prompts again and again!
The Early Veiled Shore had become something that approached the magnificence he had witnessed in Thal’dorven’s domain, though still primitive compared to what eons of development might accomplish.
The Blooming Shore represented potential that stretched toward horizons he could barely imagine, each new feature promising opportunities for advancement others could not fathom!
And he...was just getting started!

The sensation was simultaneously overwhelming and gentle.

Initiation of transformation commencing immediately.|

chapters.title: Chapter 3949: The Past and the Dead! I
paragraphs: The golden light of advancement continued to cascade across Noah’s newly transformed Blooming Shore, each wave of enhancement settling into the expanded realm.

Yet even as he stood at the epicenter of this profound transformation, even as the very fabric of his domain reshaped itself according to his will and achievement, a deeper truth swept across existence itself.

For all the magnitude of his accomplishments, for all the terrifying power he had accumulated and the impossible trials he had overcome, even he remained but a single thread in a weaving of Existence whose full scope defied comprehension!
Existence did not pause to acknowledge any triumphs.
The vast machinery of existence continued its rotation, indifferent to whether any particular being rose to greatness or fell into obscurity.
Countless eons ago, long before Noah’s name had ever been whispered into being, existence had unfolded according to its own immutable rhythms.
Its own unperceivable weavings!
Galaxies had burst into brilliant life and faded into cold darkness. Universes had expanded from singular points of density before collapsing back into the void that birthed them.

Entire Cosmos had danced their weavings across dimensions that stretched beyond imagination, each one containing within its boundaries billions upon billions of worlds, each world harboring its own stories of triumph and tragedy!

Omniverses had risen like titans from the primordial chaos, their boundaries encompassing realities so vast that the mind could not grasp their scope, only to shatter like glass when their time reached its ordained conclusion!
Wheels of Existence themselves, those fundamental constructs that served as the building blocks of Folds... had come into being and underwent Breakings and Transformations constantly.
Through all of this, existence had remained constant.
It required no single being to validate its continuation.
It needed no particular consciousness to witness its wonders.
The great machine ground on, as it always had, as it always would, producing marvels and catastrophes with equal indifference!
And yet, in the face of such overwhelming vastness, a question lingered.
What of Noah Osmont in this grand scheme of existence?
Would future beings speak of Noah Osmont with the same reverence reserved for Early Creatures? Would he even be known?

Would he become simply another story told in whispered tones, another fable shared among those who sought to understand the mysteries of power and transcendence? Another cautionary tale about the hubris of those who dared to reach beyond? Or would he not even be remembered?
The answer to this question remained shrouded in the mists of uncertainty, hidden behind veils of Quintessence!
For in the end, only time itself possessed the authority to determine which names would be remembered and which would fade into the silence of forgotten ages.

Across the infinite weavings of existence, in domains so distant from Noah’s transformed Shore that the light of his achievement would take eons to travel the space between them, other stories continued to unfold according to their own inexorable logic!

In the Transcendent Paradoxical Folds, where reality bent and twisted according to principles that defied rational understanding, a scene of deceptive simplicity played out upon a world so insignificant that its destruction would barely register as a footnote.
The world itself existed as little more than a mote of dust.

Contained within a small universe, which itself was nestled within a larger cosmos, which in turn resided within a grand Existential Domain, which was but a single component of a massive Omniverse, which finally found its place within one of the countless Wheels of Existence that formed the foundation of existence itself.
Unperceivably small!

Upon this utterly inconsequential world, in a kingdom whose borders would have seemed laughably small to beings like Living Existences, a muddy road stretched between settlements that housed creatures whose greatest ambitions involved little more than the accumulation of modest wealth and the avoidance of starvation.
The road itself bore the scars of countless seasons, its surface a treacherous mixture of churned earth and standing water that reflected the gray sky above.
Along its edges, where the grass grew thick and wild, merchants and travelers had worn narrow paths that spoke to the endless migration of those seeking better fortunes in distant lands.
Thatched-roof buildings lined the road at irregular intervals, their walls constructed from timber and stone quarried from local hills.
Smoke rose from countless chimneys, carrying with it the scent of wood fires and the simple meals that sustained populations of thousands.
Through this medieval landscape moved the procession of humanity in all its varied forms.
Farmers trudged along the muddy road with carts laden with the fruits of their labor, their faces weathered by sun and wind, their hands bearing the calluses that marked a lifetime of honest toil.
Peasants walked alongside these farmers, their clothing patched and repatched until the original fabric had become little more than a foundation for layers of practical repair.
Among these humble travelers moved figures whose very presence spoke to the rigid hierarchies that governed this simple world.
Slaves shuffled along in chains that clinked with each step, their heads bowed in submission and in the bone-deep exhaustion.
Their guards rode alongside on horseback, their hands never far from the weapons that ensured compliance with the established order.
And occasionally, carriages would roll along the road with wheels that threw mud in all directions.
Through windows of real glass, faces peered out with the casual arrogance of royalty.
It was beside this road, in a spot where the mud had pooled particularly deep and the grass grew particularly thick, that a figure sat in apparent desolation!
At first glance, he appeared to be nothing more than another casualty of a world that showed little mercy to those without means or connections.
His clothes hung in tatters around a frame that seemed diminished by hunger and exposure, their original color lost beneath layers of grime.
Yet there was something in his posture that suggested deeper truths hidden beneath!
His skin, beneath the accumulated dirt and wear of his chosen disguise, possessed a vitality that seemed to pulse with each heartbeat.

At this moment of deceptive tranquility, when the beggar sat in perfect stillness beside the muddy road while the procession of humanity continued its ancient dance around him, the very fabric of space began to distort!
BZZT!
The distortion started as little more than a shimmer in the air. But it grew with each passing second, becoming a tear in reality.
From this tear in existence descended a figure whose presence transformed the very nature of the space around him!
Duke Elagabalus materialized with slow majesty, his form radiating power.
This being of great power descended through the mundane atmosphere of a world whose greatest concerns involved the price of grain and the changing of seasons.
His ancient eyes swept across the scene below with the particular disdain.

The humans who moved along the muddy road continued their daily routines as if nothing had changed, their limited perception unable to register the presence of something that could erase their entire world from existence with less effort than swatting an insect!
Duke Elagabalus floated downward, his attention focused entirely upon the figure who sat beside the road in apparent destitution.

"You have seen everything so far?" he asked, his tone carrying the careful respect of one powerful being addressing another whose true capabilities remained hidden beneath layers of deliberate misdirection.
"We were able to obtain the body of an Early Creature as I gave Diviticus the task of reanimating it. But..."
At such a moment, the beggar smiled.
And he spoke calmly!

"What worries you is that Ozymandias," the beggar said, his voice carrying none of the weakness suggested by his appearance. Each word emerged with the clarity of crystal and the weight of absolute certainty.
"Logically, you are convinced, as you rightfully should be, that he cannot possibly be an Early Creature. This is a correct line of thought. It is only logical, but..."
He paused, allowing the silence to stretch.
"What of the infinitesimally small chance that he is an Early Creature? Is that why you came to bother me?"
An immense silence settled over the muddy road, broken only by the distant sound of carriage wheels splashing through puddles and the murmur of voices engaged in the simple business of survival.

In that silence, two beings of unimaginable power regarded each other across a gulf that separated not just their physical forms but their fundamental approaches to the mysteries that governed existence itself!

chapters.title: Chapter 3950: The Past and the Dead! II
paragraphs: Duke Elagabalus felt the weight of that silence pressing against him.
"You know already, Duke Schrodinger," he said.
"You are one of the true leaders of Paradox. If there really is a possible threat of an Early Creature for the Paradoxes, only those like you can handle it."
The beggar’s smile deepened, and suddenly the illusion of poverty seemed as thin as morning mist.
Though his clothes remained tattered and his position unchanged beside the muddy road, there was something in his bearing that spoke of terrifying Paradoxical Authority!
Schrodinger!
Oh, Schrodinger!
"Ah," Schrodinger said, "You see, Duke Elagabalus, you have stumbled upon the very heart of what it means to exist within Paradox itself."

He gestured with one hand toward the road where a merchant’s cart had just struck a particularly deep pothole, sending muddy water splashing in all directions while the driver cursed with creative eloquence.
"Consider the nature of uncertainty," Schrodinger continued, his eyes taking on that terrible brightness.

"In the realm of Paradox, we exist perpetually suspended between states of being and non-being, between possibility and impossibility. Sinners. Anchored. What is Paradox, if not the acknowledgment that reality itself refuses to conform to the simple categories that lesser minds demand?"
HUUM!
The air around them began to shimmer with barely visible energies as Schrodinger’s true nature began to bleed through his carefully constructed disguise.

"At this very moment, Ozymandias exists in a state of quantum uncertainty regarding his fundamental nature. He is simultaneously an Early Creature and not an Early Creature, a being of existential significance and a mere Fold Dweller of limited scope. His true nature remains hidden behind the veil of observation until the moment when certainty collapses possibility into a single, immutable, magisterial truth."
Duke Elagabalus found himself leaning forward despite every instinct that warned him against showing such open interest.
"But surely," he said, "there must be some way to determine-...."
"Ah, but that is where you misunderstand the beauty of true Paradox," Schrodinger interrupted with a gentle correction.

"The moment we attempt to observe and categorize, we fundamentally alter the nature of what we observe. Our very act of seeking certainty changes the parameters of the equation. Until that moment of collapse occurs, Ozymandias remains beautifully, terrifyingly uncertain."
WAA!
When Schrodinger finished these words, Duke Elagabalus released a sigh that carried the weight of eons.
"That does not advance any solution here," he said, frustration bleeding through his carefully maintained composure.
At such words, Schrodinger’s smile took on a change that transformed it from gentle amusement into something far more dangerous.
"So what if he turns out to be an Early Creature?" he asked with casual indifference.
"Are you so fearful of an Early Creature?"
BOOM!
Duke Elagabalus’s response came without hesitation, driven by honesty!

"Yes," he said, and there was no shame in his admission. "I am very much afraid of an Early Creature. Anyone with sense of logic would be. Anyone who does not fear an Early Creature knows nothing of existence!"
The admission rang across the muddy road with the clarity of absolute truth.
Schrodinger’s smile widened at these words, and he shook his head with patient amusement.

"Fear," he said, "is nothing more than the mind’s response to that which it cannot understand or control. We fear the darkness because we cannot see what moves within it. We fear death because we cannot comprehend what lies beyond the veil of existence. We fear Early Creatures because their power operates according to principles that transcend our ability to categorize or predict."
He paused to watch as another carriage rolled past, its wheels throwing muddy water in all directions while the occupants remained blissfully unaware of who was around them!

"But fear, you see, is born from ignorance. Once something is truly understood, once its nature is catalogued and its capabilities mapped, fear transforms into something else entirely. It becomes respect, perhaps, or caution, or even admiration. But fear itself dissolves like mist before the sun of comprehension."
Duke Elagabalus remained silent, his ancient mind working to process everything.
At this moment of contemplative quiet, Schrodinger’s expression shifted to something that carried absolute confidence!
"I do not fear any Early Creature," he said with calm certainty, "because I have means to protect myself and you all if an Early Creature does ever come to light."
Oh!
"What?" he demanded, his composure cracking. "How?!"
Schrodinger smiled as he looked out across the muddy road.

At that precise moment, a particularly ornate carriage approached their position, its wheels striking a deep pothole with enough force to send a cascade of wet mud splashing across Schrodinger’s already tattered robes.

He wiped away the filth with movements that spoke to infinite patience, his expression never changing even as the royal occupant of the carriage looked down at him with an expression of supreme arrogance before proceeding along the road without a backward glance.
Schrodinger did nothing about this casual insult, his attention already returning to the matters that truly demanded his focus.
"To understand this," he said, "you would have to recollect something from the Stories of the Earliest Folds. Do you remember what happened after Paradox was locked away the first time?"
Duke Elagabalus felt his expression shift to one of weary resignation.
"Duke Schrodinger," he said, "I have heard the Stories of the Earliest Folds countless times. I don’t want to-"
"And you will now listen to it again another time," Schrodinger interrupted, his voice taking on the stern authority of one who would accept no argument!
Duke Elagabalus fell silent, recognizing the futility of resistance when faced with such a being.
Schrodinger settled back against the muddy home, his eyes taking on the distant look of one who gazed across eons to witness events that had shaped existence itself!
When he began to speak, his voice carried the cadence someone telling...a version of a story!

"The Creature moved across the Earliest Folds with a sense of melancholy," he began, "as it found that uniquely, it missed The Living Paradox. Having been with it for so long, it found that it actually missed its company!"

Schrodinger smiled as he looked out across the muddy road.

At that precise moment, a particularly ornate carriage approached their position, its wheels striking a deep pothole with enough force to send a cascade of wet mud splashing across Schrodinger’s already tattered robes.

He wiped away the filth with movements that spoke to infinite patience, his expression never changing even as the royal occupant of the carriage looked down at him with an expression of supreme arrogance before proceeding along the road without a backward glance.
Schrodinger did nothing about this casual insult, his attention already returning to the matters that truly demanded his focus.
"To understand this," he said, "you would have to recollect something from the Stories of the Earliest Folds.
Do you remember what happened after Paradox was locked away the first time?"
Duke Elagabalus felt his expression shift to one of weary resignation.
"Duke Schrodinger," he said, "I have heard the Stories of the Earliest Folds countless times.
I don’t want to-"
"And you will now listen to it again another time," Schrodinger interrupted, his voice taking on the stern authority of one who would accept no argument!
Duke Elagabalus fell silent, recognizing the futility of resistance when faced with such a being.
Schrodinger settled back against the muddy home, his eyes taking on the distant look of one who gazed across eons to witness events that had shaped existence itself!
When he began to speak, his voice carried the cadence someone telling...a version of a story!
"The Creature moved across the Earliest Folds with a sense of melancholy," he began, "as it found that uniquely, it missed The Living Paradox.
Having been with it for so long, it found that it actually missed its company!"

chapters.title: Chapter 3951: The Past and the Dead! III
paragraphs: "So The Creature had purpose and a beginning, but yet found itself longing for a company it knew was not good for it.
To make up for this absence, The Creature went to observe all the things born from the spread of its Everything by the Living Paradox.
And...the closest Lifeforms it enjoyed seeing, as if they were its own children, were the Early Creatures."

Schrodinger’s voice took on notes of paternal sadness as he continued. "It observed them. How they were trying to find their own purpose. But they stumbled. They constantly fought with Inevitabilities, for after The Living Paradox was locked away, Inevitabilities became even more rampant throughout the Earliest Folds."
The tragedy began to unfold as Schrodinger painted pictures with words!
"The Creature had the now immensely powerful Living Origin and The Living Concept constantly protecting it, so it did not have to worry about such threats.
But the Early Creatures...its children, began to die in the hands of Inevitabilities!

It hurt it tremendously every time it observed this injustice, so it traversed across the Folds and called together The Living Elemental, Living Origin, Living Concept, Living Spirit, Living Dimension, Living Law, Living Temporal, Living Emotive, and Living Quantum."
Duke Elagabalus found himself leaning forward despite his earlier reluctance, caught up in the flow of narrative he heard many times before, but the details in this one seemed much clearer!
"He gathered them and said he wished to protect the fruits of his Everything, and wanted to build something that would help the poor Lifeforms gain the power to fight against Inevitabilities.
Hesitant, THE Living Existences looked at each other before ultimately... they agreed to work with The Creature to create a place of refuge and potential for progression of power that they deemed...
The Early Veiled Shores!"
HUUM!
The Early Veiled Shores...those legendary realms that existed at the very foundations of power itself, had been born from The Creature’s desire to protect its children.
"The Creature was extremely happy at this collaboration," Schrodinger continued, "as he told THE Living Existences that they would not regret this decision.
They worked for an entire eon until they designed and scattered Early Veiled Shores for Early Creatures to use as refuge and as lands to elevate their own Everything.

The Creature received his own Early Veiled Shore that was made unfathomably unique, and he found himself lost in the designs he helped to make himself as he began spending lots of time in this small, isolated domain.
In his own shore.

After he saw the Early Creatures obtained the Early Veiled Shores and could hide from Inevitabilities and even begin growing themselves, he left them to their devices, content with what he had done as he disappeared...lost in his own Shore."
But the story did not end with triumph and harmony as one somehow hoped.

"In the meantime, the Early Creatures progressed. They grew strong over the eons and successfully became powerful enough through their Shores to fight and win against extremely terrifying Inevitabilities. But with power came... chaos."
The inevitable tragedy began to unfold as Schrodinger’s voice took on notes of disappointment.
"The Early Creatures gradually began vying for supremacy, going across the Folds and beginning cycles of untold chaos.
They took under their banner Inevitabilities, Living Lifeforms, and all sorts of other Lifeforms for the sake of their Shores.
And from peace... chaos began to propagate wildly."
"And because THE Living Order was destroyed in the fight against Paradox, there was no return to Order!
And without order, what could there be apart from chaos?
And so, Early Creatures lived as they wished!
Chaos spread across the Earliest Folds.
The balance that had been so carefully constructed began to crumble as those who had been saved by The Creature’s intervention turned their gifts toward conquest and domination.
The Living Law could not stand the chaos.
It went before the Early Creatures and admonished them, telling them this was not what they and THE Creature had envisioned.
But the Early Creatures did not listen.
They said the only one they would listen to was not here, and had not shown himself for eons.
The futility of trying to restore order through mere words became apparent as power without restraint...inevitably led to corruption and conflict.
So the chaos continued!
The Living Law was furious at the violation of order as it set off to the lands where Inevitabilities had first risen.
It searched for a solution in a place filed with uncertain possibilities!
There, after countless perils, it found something from the chaos of Inevitabilities and Everything... in the form of a Herb."
Schrodinger’s voice dropped to barely above a whisper as he reached the climax of his tale.
"A simple herb, and yet the Living Law felt an indescribable wonder from it.
It spent its Law and ordered the herb to be understood by it.
It was shocked as the herb it found... turned out to be the answer to the problem of Early Creatures!
It was a herb that could...heavily weaken and take down unruly Early Creatures!"
HUUM!
The Story of the Earliest Folds being told by Schrodinger ended there, leaving Duke Elagabalus staring at the beggar with expressions that mixed shock with incredulity.
"Are you saying," Duke Elagabalus asked, his voice barely steady, "that you... have found what The Living Law found all those Ages ago?!"
At such a question, Schrodinger only smiled and leaned back against the muddy area, his eyes taking on that unfathomably bright brilliance.
He offered no answer, but his silence carried more weight than any words could have conveyed.
In that moment, beside a muddy road on an insignificant world in the depths of the Transcendent Paradoxical Folds, the balance of power shifted in ways that would echo across existence itself.
And it was silent.
Surrounded by weak humans that knew nothing!
And somewhere, in a place beyond imagination, Noah Osmont continued his own journey toward greatness.
Isolated.
Not at all too worried about others!

chapters.title: Chapter 3952: My Foundation is Complete! I
paragraphs: The golden sands of the Blooming Shore stretched beneath Noah’s bare feet like crushed starlight given form, each grain pulsing with the accumulated authority of his recent advancement.

The sensation was intoxicating in its completeness...warm without heat, substantial without weight, alive with possibilities that seemed to whisper directly into his consciousness with every step he took across this transformed place!
He stood at the heart of his expanded domain, his upper body bare to the crystalline winds that swept across territories that had grown beyond all previous limitations.
Occasionally, as he walked through this paradise of his own design, new prompts would materialize before him.
|The Maximum Population of the Early Veiled Shore has been increased to 100.|
There were many that continued to trickle over as the land waited for him to give his directiona!

Yet among all these wonders, what captured his attention most profoundly were the connections that now existed to Records of other Early Veiled Shores...pathways that stretched across impossible distances!
Records.
Records meant that the Shores themselves no longer existed in their original form.
They had become echoes, memories given structure and substance but no longer truly alive with the presence of those who had created them.
Noah’s mind turned inevitably to the continuation of the Stories of the Earliest Folds that Sigrid had shared with him.
He understood now why Living Existences looked upon such beings with reverence that bordered on subservience and fear!
He thought of the chaos and wonder that Early Creatures had brought to existence itself.

And he thought of THE Living Law, driven by necessity to seek something in the chaotic birthplace of Inevitabilities...something that she had utilized to restore a semblance of balance to Existence itself.
Some called it a weapon in their retelling of the Story. Others whispered of it as a poison specifically crafted to bring low beings whose power exceeded all normal categories of measurement.
But whatever its true nature, THE Living Law had wielded it to bring about Order where chaos had threatened to consume everything.
Yet Early Creatures had not been destroyed at that time. The Stories made that much clear!
So what had happened to them? Who possessed sufficient power to erase entities whose capabilities transcended every normal limitation?
The questions burned in his consciousness, demanding answers that remained frustratingly beyond his reach.
As these thoughts churned through his mind, Noah felt the pulse of his own existence.
His progression continued to unfold according to principles that defied every normal expectation, unperceivable and quintessential in nature!

Right now, his Complexity and Purity Quotients had spilled past the sixty million marker. But when he considered his Refined and Basic Early Living Existential Glyphs alongside these raw measurements, when he calculated the true scope of his collective capabilities...
His actual power had already spilled past one hundred million.
The boundary between Fold Dwellers and Living Existences- that fundamental threshold that defined the very nature of hierarchy...had been crossed silently, without fanfare or ceremony.
When it came to his CQ and PQ, he was waiting to hit 75 Million before forming his first Eminent Early Living Existential Glyph!
But even though he had yet to reach that number, his actual power already spilled past Originus Venerant.
For him, it was not even some grand achievement worthy of celebration. The transition had occurred as naturally as breathing!
Those were their definitions and distinctions, after all. The categories that others used to measure and understand power simply did not apply to a being like him.

Standing upon the golden sands of his Shore, feeling the crystalline winds pass over his resplendent skin like the caress of infinity itself, Noah spoke with calm certainty that carried across his domain like a proclamation.
"As of this moment," he said, his voice resonating through the Shore that existed beyond normal space, "my foundation could be considered complete."
HUUM!
His foundation.
Everything before this moment...every trial overcome, every power gained, every impossible feat accomplished...he deemed nothing more than the laying of groundwork for what was to come!
BOOM!
The moment these words left his lips, the very fabric of existence around him began to pulse with recognition.
The Early Veiled Shore itself seemed to buzz with glory!
Moiraine, whose eyes were still blazing from the encounter of a Record of an Early Creature, watched on.
Heidrun, this glutton, had her eyes bright as she was chewing more Auric Vitae Grass freely while she nodded her head.
Golden light erupted from the crystalline sands beneath his feet, rising in spirals that wrapped around his form like coronation robes woven from pure authority.
The sensation was overwhelming and gentle simultaneously.
New information began cascading across his awareness as his existence corrected itself!

|Your existence has become more defined according to principles that predate all current understanding of power and progression. Through achievement that transcends normal categories of possibility, your own Exclusive Realms have now been designed.|

|Foundation Stage: The Early Primordial Genesis - Complete. This stage encompasses the fundamental building of power according to your own weavings of existence and Early Creature principles, establishing the basic architecture upon which all future advancement will be built. Characteristics: Complete formation of first Heart component, establishment of multiple Sacred Totems, accumulation of 100+ Million total collective complexity and purity source units.|

|The Next Exclusive Realm that will define you has been deemed by your weavings of existence as The Early Throne Ascendancy Realm- At the peak of this realm, you will attain power equivalent to a true Early Creature of the earliest epochs. Progression requirements: All 150+ Early Sacred Totems of Osmont advanced to the Fourth Stage, complete all components of the Heart of an Early Creature, and attain 10,000 Kleos Early Living Existential Glyphs. Other requirements may arise as you learn more regarding existence. This realm marks the transition from foundation to true existential significance.|

|The Third Exclusive Realm: The Early Infinity Dominion - Even your current understanding cannot grasp what lies at the peak of this realm. What awaits beyond this threshold remains shrouded in mystery that transcends current comprehension.|
The information settled into his consciousness, each detail finding its proper place within the greater structure of understanding that governed his unique path toward transcendence.
Where others might have been overwhelmed by the scope of what lay ahead, he found only anticipation burning in his chest like a steady flame.
And oh, was he fucking steady!
The golden winds of his Blooming Shore carried with them the scent of infinite possibility.
Behind him, the Sacred Totems that dotted his expanded domain pulsed with sympathetic resonance, their bells remaining silent but ready to ring once more!
Noah stretched slightly as right after, his voice boomed out.
"Alright, lets fully utilize this glorious Shore, shall we?!"
HUUM!

chapters.title: Chapter 3953: My Foundation is Complete! II
paragraphs: The Blooming Shore stretched around him like a canvas waiting to be painted with wonders that had not been seen since the earliest epochs of existence, each feature demanding exploration and understanding!
Yet before he could delve into the mysteries of Early Folds or test the limits of his expanded capabilities, practical necessity demanded his attention.
The requirements for designating any plot of land as an Early Fold were precise and unforgiving- he would need prerequisite seeds!
Standing upon the golden sands that pulsed with the rhythm of his heartbeat, Noah raised his voice as it echoed out.
"Initiate the opening of the trade network connected to the Record of the Blooming Shore of the Early Creature designated as Thal’dorven the Primordial Fisher."
HUUM!
The response was immediate and overwhelming.
In front of his eyes, reality itself seemed to fold and reshape as an illusory golden screen bloomed into existence with the majesty of a wheel being born.
The manifestation was breathtaking in its complexity, each mote of light that comprised its surface carrying information.
|Trade Network Connection Established Successfully. Resource exchange parameters now operational.|

|The accumulated treasures and cultivation achievements of an Early Creature who mastered the arts of marine cultivation and Shore development are now accessible through established trade. Exchange rates determined by relative scarcity and fundamental value across existential hierarchies.|

|Warning: All transactions are conducted with the Record of the Blooming Shore. Nature of receiving entity remains undefined. Exercise appropriate caution when engaging in exchanges involving personal essence or irreplaceable resources.|
As these words settled into his consciousness, the screen transformed before his eyes into something that resembled a glorious marketplace of impossible scope and grandeur.

At the very top of the display, written in letters that seemed to burn with their own inner fire, appeared the designation: |Vault of the Blooming Shore of the Early Creature, Thal’dorven the Primordial Fisher.|

Below this header, the screen organized itself into distinct sections that pulsed with their own unique radiance, each one promising access to resources that could reshape the nature of existence itself.
Noah’s enhanced perception observed them with growing amazement:
|Early Sacred Herbs, Early Sacred Produce, Early Living Marine Lifeforms, Early Sacred Tools, Fold Seeds, Architectural Blueprints...|
Each section glowed with a different hue, creating a symphony of light that spoke to the vast diversity of treasures that awaited his exploration.
The very sight of such abundance made his chest tighten with anticipation!
When he focused his attention upon the section marked, Early Sacred Herbs, the screen responded to his interest with eager compliance.
Suddenly, the display exploded with radiant vegetation that seemed to pulse with their own living light.
Hundreds upon hundreds of herbs materialized before his eyes, each one more magnificent than anything he had previously encountered!
Some appeared as simple flowers whose petals contained compressed Wheels of Existence, while others resembled trees whose branches stretched across dimensional boundaries.
His gaze settled upon two specimens that commanded attention through sheer presence alone.
The first was a delicate flower that seemed to be crafted from crystallized moonlight, its petals shifting through spectrums of color that had no names in any known language.
When he focused upon it, information flowed into his consciousness.
|Early Sacred Herb: Lustral Purity Blossom|

|Effect: Consumption grants exactly 50,000,000 Purity Quotient enhancement with no diminishing returns. Maximum consumption limit: 10 specimens per individual existence. Total potential enhancement: 500,000,000 Purity Quotient.|
|Exchange Requirements: 1 Eminent Early Living Existential Glyph, OR Early Sacred Lifeblood Herb (Equivalent rarity), OR 100 Drops of Early Creature Blood.|

|Note: This herb represents one of the foundational tools used by Early Creatures to establish the basic architecture required for transcendent advancement. Its cultivation requires specific temporal and spatial conditions that exist only within Plots properly maintained Early Veiled Shores. High chance of finding this herb in the Living Doorways of the Loom|
A ridiculous herb that granted ridiculous boons!
Yet its cost...
His eyes flashed sharply as he measured everything.
The second specimen that caught his attention was even more extraordinary- a plant that seemed to exist in multiple weavings of existence simultaneously, its form shifting between states of being.
|Early Sacred Herb: Sovereign Law Genesis Vine|

|Effect: Consumption grants 10 Kleos Early Living Existential Glyphs of Law, permanently integrated into the consumer’s existential weavings. These Glyphs cannot be removed, replicated, or transferred under any circumstances. Low chance of finding this herb in the Living Doorways of the Loom.|
|Exchange Requirements: 10,000 Drops of Early Creature Blood, OR Weavings of 25% of an entire Blooming Shore (Irreversible transfer).|
|Warning: Recommend extreme caution before proceeding with exchange.|
Noah stared at these two resources with growing alarm, his mind calculating the implications.
He currently possessed fewer than one thousand drops of his Blood, making the requirement of ten thousand seem not just expensive but potentially catastrophic.
Even the herb requiring one hundred drops gave him pause and raised questions!

Exactly who would be the recipient of his blood? The dead Early Creature whose Record maintained this marketplace? The question caused him to freeze with caution, every instinct honed through countless trials screaming warnings about the dangers of surrendering essence to unknown entities.
The silence that followed was heavy with unspoken concerns as Noah contemplated the wisdom of such exchanges.
His blood was not merely a resource. To surrender it carelessly could invite consequences that stretched far beyond simple transaction!
Pushing aside these troubling thoughts for the moment, Noah turned his attention to the other sections of the miraculous marketplace, his curiosity driving him to explore despite his growing caution.
When he focused upon Early Sacred Produce, the screen filled with fruits and vegetables that seemed to pulse with concentrated life force.
One item immediately captured his attention, a golden apple whose surface seemed to contain swirling nebulae.
|Early Sacred Produce: Vitality Nexus Apple|
|Effect: Consumption permanently increases progression of complexity and purity rates by 1000%. Moderate chance of finding this produce seed in the Living Doorways of the Loom.|
|Exchange Requirements: 500 Drops of Early Creature Blood, OR Complete architectural blueprints for Third-Stage Sacred Totem construction.|
He looked, and turned away.

The Early Sacred Tools section revealed implements that defied normal categories of understanding. A crystalline hammer caught his eye, its surface reflecting dimensions that seemed to exist sideways to normal reality.
|Early Sacred Tool: Reality Forging Mallet of Thal’dorven|

|Effect: Allows the wielder to directly reshape the fundamental properties of any material or energy within their Shore. Can be used to enhance Sacred Totems beyond normal limitations or other unique constructs|
|Exchange Requirements: 500 Drops of Early Creature Blood, OR Sacrifice of 3 completed Sacred Totems at the Third Stage or higher.|
This, he also looked at and turned his eyes away from!

In front of his eyes, reality itself seemed to fold and reshape as an illusory golden screen bloomed into existence with the majesty of a wheel being born.
The manifestation was breathtaking in its complexity, each mote of light that comprised its surface carrying information.
|Trade Network Connection Established Successfully.
Resource exchange parameters now operational.|
|The accumulated treasures and cultivation achievements of an Early Creature who mastered the arts of marine cultivation and Shore development are now accessible through established trade.
Exchange rates determined by relative scarcity and fundamental value across existential hierarchies.|
|Warning: All transactions are conducted with the Record of the Blooming Shore.
Nature of receiving entity remains undefined.
Exercise appropriate caution when engaging in exchanges involving personal essence or irreplaceable resources.|
As these words settled into his consciousness, the screen transformed before his eyes into something that resembled a glorious marketplace of impossible scope and grandeur.

At the very top of the display, written in letters that seemed to burn with their own inner fire, appeared the designation: |Vault of the Blooming Shore of the Early Creature, Thal’dorven the Primordial Fisher.|

Below this header, the screen organized itself into distinct sections that pulsed with their own unique radiance, each one promising access to resources that could reshape the nature of existence itself.
Noah’s enhanced perception observed them with growing amazement:
|Early Sacred Herbs, Early Sacred Produce, Early Living Marine Lifeforms, Early Sacred Tools, Fold Seeds, Architectural Blueprints...|
Each section glowed with a different hue, creating a symphony of light that spoke to the vast diversity of treasures that awaited his exploration.
The very sight of such abundance made his chest tighten with anticipation!
When he focused his attention upon the section marked, Early Sacred Herbs, the screen responded to his interest with eager compliance.
Suddenly, the display exploded with radiant vegetation that seemed to pulse with their own living light.
Hundreds upon hundreds of herbs materialized before his eyes, each one more magnificent than anything he had previously encountered!
Some appeared as simple flowers whose petals contained compressed Wheels of Existence, while others resembled trees whose branches stretched across dimensional boundaries.
His gaze settled upon two specimens that commanded attention through sheer presence alone.
The first was a delicate flower that seemed to be crafted from crystallized moonlight, its petals shifting through spectrums of color that had no names in any known language.
When he focused upon it, information flowed into his consciousness.
|Early Sacred Herb: Lustral Purity Blossom|
|Effect: Consumption grants exactly 50,000,000 Purity Quotient enhancement with no diminishing returns.
Maximum consumption limit: 10 specimens per individual existence.
Total potential enhancement: 500,000,000 Purity Quotient.|
|Exchange Requirements: 1 Eminent Early Living Existential Glyph, OR Early Sacred Lifeblood Herb (Equivalent rarity), OR 100 Drops of Early Creature Blood.|
|Note: This herb represents one of the foundational tools used by Early Creatures to establish the basic architecture required for transcendent advancement.
Its cultivation requires specific temporal and spatial conditions that exist only within Plots properly maintained Early Veiled Shores.
High chance of finding this herb in the Living Doorways of the Loom|
A ridiculous herb that granted ridiculous boons!
Yet its cost...
His eyes flashed sharply as he measured everything.
The second specimen that caught his attention was even more extraordinary- a plant that seemed to exist in multiple weavings of existence simultaneously, its form shifting between states of being.
|Early Sacred Herb: Sovereign Law Genesis Vine|
|Effect: Consumption grants 10 Kleos Early Living Existential Glyphs of Law, permanently integrated into the consumer’s existential weavings.
These Glyphs cannot be removed, replicated, or transferred under any circumstances.
Low chance of finding this herb in the Living Doorways of the Loom.|
|Exchange Requirements: 10,000 Drops of Early Creature Blood, OR Weavings of 25% of an entire Blooming Shore (Irreversible transfer).|
|Warning: Recommend extreme caution before proceeding with exchange.|
Noah stared at these two resources with growing alarm, his mind calculating the implications.
He currently possessed fewer than one thousand drops of his Blood, making the requirement of ten thousand seem not just expensive but potentially catastrophic.
Even the herb requiring one hundred drops gave him pause and raised questions!
Exactly who would be the recipient of his blood?
The dead Early Creature whose Record maintained this marketplace?
The question caused him to freeze with caution, every instinct honed through countless trials screaming warnings about the dangers of surrendering essence to unknown entities.
The silence that followed was heavy with unspoken concerns as Noah contemplated the wisdom of such exchanges.
His blood was not merely a resource.
To surrender it carelessly could invite consequences that stretched far beyond simple transaction!
Pushing aside these troubling thoughts for the moment, Noah turned his attention to the other sections of the miraculous marketplace, his curiosity driving him to explore despite his growing caution.
When he focused upon Early Sacred Produce, the screen filled with fruits and vegetables that seemed to pulse with concentrated life force.
One item immediately captured his attention, a golden apple whose surface seemed to contain swirling nebulae.
|Early Sacred Produce: Vitality Nexus Apple|
|Effect: Consumption permanently increases progression of complexity and purity rates by 1000%.
Moderate chance of finding this produce seed in the Living Doorways of the Loom.|
|Exchange Requirements: 500 Drops of Early Creature Blood, OR Complete architectural blueprints for Third-Stage Sacred Totem construction.|
He looked, and turned away.
The Early Sacred Tools section revealed implements that defied normal categories of understanding.
A crystalline hammer caught his eye, its surface reflecting dimensions that seemed to exist sideways to normal reality.
|Early Sacred Tool: Reality Forging Mallet of Thal’dorven|
|Effect: Allows the wielder to directly reshape the fundamental properties of any material or energy within their Shore.
Can be used to enhance Sacred Totems beyond normal limitations or other unique constructs|
|Exchange Requirements: 500 Drops of Early Creature Blood, OR Sacrifice of 3 completed Sacred Totems at the Third Stage or higher.|
This, he also looked at and turned his eyes away from!

chapters.title: Chapter 3954: My Foundation is Complete! III
paragraphs: But it was in the Fold Seeds section that Noah encountered something that made his eyes pulse.
A single seed floated in isolation at the center of the display, its surface so dark it seemed to absorb light itself.
|Fold Seed: Genesis of Unbound Existence|

|Effect: Grants understanding of the Lost Forgotten Principle of Unbound Existence once matured inside a designated Early Fold Plot. Low chance of finding this herb in the Living Doorways of the Loom. |
|Exchange Requirements: 50,000 Drops of Early Creature Blood, OR Complete dissolution and absorption of 75% of a Blooming Shore with all its accumulated treasures and Lifeforms.|
Oh!
Noah’s expression grew increasingly grim as he absorbed the details of these miraculous resources!

A pattern was emerging that filled him with both wonder and deep concern- many of the herbs and produce listed in the marketplace could potentially be found in the Living Doorways of the Loom, those treacherous passages that led toward the ultimate prize of existence.
His instincts told him with absolute certainty that he should not exchange his blood.
There were too many unknowns, too many potential consequences that could reshape the very foundations of his existence in ways he could not predict or control.
"What item on here will take Auric Vitae Grasses as a resource for exchange?" he asked aloud, his voice carrying the weight of careful calculation.
A golden light flashed across the screen in response to his query, and new information materialized before his eyes like a gift offered by existence itself.
|Early Sacred Herb: Foundation Strengthening Root|
|Effect: Consumption grants 1,000,000 Complexity Quotient and 1,000,000 Purity Quotient enhancement with no diminishing returns. Can be consumed 100 times with consistent effects.|

|Exchange Requirements: 100 shoots of Auric Vitae Grass per specimen. Quality grades affect exchange ratios- Superior grade reduces requirement to 75 shoots, Pristine grade reduces requirement to 50 shoots.|
|Note: This represents one of the most fundamental cultivation aids used by Early Creatures to establish proper foundation. Regular consumption during advancement phases ensures optimal development.|
Noah felt a smile spread across his features as understanding crystallized into decision.
This was an exchange he could make, a transaction that aligned with both his current resources and his long-term goals for advancement!
"Buy," he declared with calm authority.

A brilliant light flashed across the screen as the transaction completed itself, and Noah felt the subtle shift in reality that marked the successful acquisition of resources that could accelerate his progression beyond normal limitations.
A multicolored root appeared in his hands, its mere existence buzzing with age and power as he analyzed it!
Not just for purposes of eating...but also whether it could he replanted in his own Early Veiled Shore!
But as the light gradually faded and the marketplace returned to its previous state, Noah came to two conclusions that would reshape his approach to the challenges that lay ahead.
First, his blood was unfathomably precious and desperately wanted by forces he did not yet understand.

The sheer scale of the exchange rates demanded for his essence spoke to value that transcended normal principles, suggesting that Early Creature blood represented something far more significant than mere biological fluid.
Second, and perhaps more importantly, the Living Doorways of the Loom contained treasures that could elevate any being to heights of power previously considered impossible.
It was why Living Existences were so fervant about it!

If he was to achieve the progression required for his Exclusive Realms, if he was to become what he truly wanted to be, he would need to seriously delve into those treacherous passages alongside the usage of his Early Veiled Shore, especially if he did not want to pay with his Blood.
The path forward was clear, even if the destination remained shrouded in uncertainty.
The Doorways of the Loom beckoned with promises of advancement that could not be ignored, no matter how dangerous the journey might prove to be!

Standing upon his Blooming Shore, surrounded by wonders that defied imagination, Noah began planning for the trials that would define his Existence as on this day, with a completed foundation, he began his first steps in his own...Early Throne Ascendancy Realm!
In the infinite weavings of existence, there existed a fundamental divide that touched every conscious being across all the weavings of reality.
It was a distinction so basic, so elemental, that it formed the very foundation upon which all understanding of life and death was built.
There were those who were Living, and those who were Dead.
Simple.
Straightforward.
Undeniable!
This truth echoed through every Fold, every Wheel of Existence, every domain where consciousness dared to take root.

Fold Dwellers across the vast expanse of existence found themselves categorized by this simple yet profound distinction...they drew breath and thought and dreamed, or they had surrendered these gifts to the endless silence that claimed all things in time.
Yet existence, in its infinite complexity, refused to be bound by such simple categories!
For when beings exceeded a certain level of power, when their accumulated authority transcended the normal limitations that governed them, even Dead Things became something greater.
They shed the chains of death like discarded clothing, ascending to heights where the very concepts of life and death became meaningless distinctions.

Amongst the ten Foldless Ones, the ten types of Living Existences who commanded the fundamental forces that shaped Existences itself...there was not a single entity that could be considered truly Dead.
Even those who had once known the embrace of death transcended such limitations when they achieved the heights of Living Existence, their existence elevated beyond the reach of death’s final claim.
This observation led to a question for those who dared to contemplate the deepest mysteries of existence- Where, in all the vast expanse of Existence, were the Dead?
Where, across the infinite Folds that contained countless civilizations and uncounted souls, were those who remained truly, indubitably, unperceivably dead?
Was everything Living after surpassing Originus Venerant? After becoming a Living Existence?
It was a question that very few dared to ask, for the implications of its answer touched upon truths too vast and terrible for most minds to bear!
And even fewer possessed the knowledge necessary to provide an answer that would satisfy the scope of such an inquiry.
For the dead did not simply cease to exist...they went somewhere!
They found their way to domains that existed beyond the reach of Living Existences, domains where different rules governed the nature of consciousness and purpose!

chapters.title: Chapter 3955: The Rich and the Poor! I
paragraphs: In another Weaving of Existence, removed from the familiar territories where Living Existences pursued their endless struggles for advancement and dominion, lay a domain that existed according to principles that would have driven most conscious entities to madness with their profound wrongness.

This was an unknown place, a forgotten corner of Existence where the fundamental laws that governed Existence, life, and death had been twisted into configurations that served purposes too alien for normal comprehension.
The entire domain was crafted from obsidian that gleamed with inner light that somehow managed to convey both beauty and despair in equal measure.
The obsidian stretched in all directions, forming landscapes of impossible weavings where black crystal formations rose like the bones of dead titans!
The air itself seemed thick with the weight of accumulated sorrow, each breath carrying flavors that spoke to loss on an existential scale.
At the heart of this dreary magnificence lay something that defied every expectation of what an Early Veiled Shore should represent.
Where such domains typically embodied life and growth and infinite possibility, this Shore spoke only of endings and decay and the terrible finality of death given form.
Finality!

The waters that should have sparkled with crystalline clarity were instead murky and black, their surface reflecting no light as they lapped against shores of sand that had been ground from the bones of forgotten civilizations.
Each grain carried within it the compressed essence of dreams that would never be fulfilled, ambitions that had been cut short by forces too vast to resist.
The trees that dotted this desolate landscape stood as monuments to futility itself!
Their branches reached skyward with the desperate grasping of those who sought salvation that would never come, their bark scarred by wounds that wept sap as black as midnight.
No leaves adorned their twisted limbs, no fruit offered sustenance to those who might seek shelter in their shadow.
Sacred Totems that had once rung with the music of harmony lay shattered across the blackened sands, their bells cracked and silent.
The very foundations upon which they had been built showed signs of violence so profound it had left scars in the fabric of existence itself.
Shrines that should have housed the accumulated wisdom of ages stood as hollow shells, their sacred spaces defiled by forces that recognized no sanctity!
The plots of land that should have nurtured miraculous growth lay barren and poisoned, their soil so thoroughly corrupted that nothing would ever grow there again.
At the center of this nightmare landscape sat a figure that commanded attention through sheer presence alone, despite the terrible wounds that marked its form.
The Early Creature bore the unmistakable signs of one who had achieved the heights of power, its muscled frame speaking to strength that had once commanded the respect of Living Existences.
Its bare chest was a map of violence, each scar telling stories of battles fought against forces unperceivable to many!
But it was the head that drew the eye with horrifying fascination.
A massive gash split the skull nearly in half, running from the crown all the way down to the neck with surgical precision.
The wound gaped open like a second mouth, revealing depths that seemed to contain swirling darkness rather than the biological structures that should have existed beneath bone and flesh!
Yet despite injuries that should have resulted in immediate death for any normal being, the creature blinked with eyes that burned with terrible awareness.

Before it floated a flickering obsidian screen that pulsed with the same dark radiance that permeated the entire realm, its surface displaying information that remained hidden from external observation.

In this landscape of absolute desolation, where hope had been systematically eliminated and beauty existed only to emphasize the magnitude of loss, the Early Creature’s voice echoed with authority that made the very foundations of reality tremble.
"Blood..." it said, each syllable dripping with hunger that transcended normal desire.
"All I want... is Blood!"
HUUM!

As it said so, behind him could be seen green gold grasses trying to pierce into thr black sand to give them some color, but the moment they did so, there was only a dim glow gained that seemed like it would be eaten up in a matter of hours!
Death...permeated here far too potently.
And in constrast...there were other places filled with the overabundance of life!

In the Transcendent Origin Battlefront Folds, where the struggle between order and chaos played out on a stage vast enough to contain the ambitions of many powers, the magnificent citadel of Aeternitas Concordia rose against horizons that stretched beyond imagination.

Outside this monument to cooperation between forces of Living Existences, contained within a bubble of golden radiance that bent light around its surface like a lens focused on infinity, Noah floated alongside beings whose combined Existences were far too bright!
Sigrid stood beside him with the poise of one who had never doubted her right to command the attention of the most powerful beings in existence.

Altheon maintained his position behind them with the patient watchfulness. The Prime Living Origin’s luminous form pulsed with barely contained energy, ready to defend his charges against threats that might emerge from any direction.

Three Honored Living Existences completed their immediate retinue, their presence adding layers of protection that would have made even Honored Living Existences pause before considering aggressive action!
The golden bubble that contained them existed beyond the reach of casual observation, its surface configured to deflect even the enhanced perceptions of Honored Living Existences.

Duke Gwendolyn had listened to the demands of Sigrid’s with careful attention. When she had finally agreed, it was to provide protection for their journey into the Living Doorways of the Loom, and her acquiescence had come with conditions that reflected the true magnitude of the dangers they would face!
"If you are to truly traverse across the Doorways of the Loom," she had declared, "you will go with a team composed of entities I personally select to ensure your survival."

chapters.title: Chapter 3956: The Rich and the Poor! II
paragraphs: Sigrid had agreed to these terms without hesitation. Altheon was one, but the identity of the others who would join their expedition remained a source of curiosity.
WAP!

The distinctive sound of spatial displacement announced Duke Gwendolyn’s return to their protective bubble, her arrival accompanied by two figures whose presence immediately shifted the balance of power within their confined space.

Duke Gwendolyn herself was a vision of regality that transcended normal concepts of beauty and authority. Her stellar dark hair seemed to contain entire galaxies within its depths, while her tan skin radiated warmth.
The Living Origin Authority that cascaded over her form like liquid starlight!
But it was the two beings who accompanied her that caused Noah’s expression to shift.
The first figure resembled a titan carved from white-gold radiance, its muscled frame speaking to physical power that could have crushed Wheels with casual gestures.
The second entity presented a study in contrasts.

It appeared as a verdant fairy-like creature whose delicate features might have inspired artists across countless civilizations, yet its expression carried coldness that suggested it viewed everything in existence as fundamentally beneath its notice.
Despite its seemingly fragile appearance, the power that radiated from this being made even Noah’s eyes observe a level of authority that operated on the level of Royal Living Existences.
The casual indifference within its gaze was potent!

Duke Gwendolyn gestured toward the fairy-like entity with movements that carried the precise elegance of introduction. "This is Royal Living Origin Thessaly, the Weaver of Reversed Existence," she announced.
"Of all Living Origins, she possesses the unique capability to reverse the collapse of any existence that has occurred within a day, so long as she bears witness to the event."
HUUM!
To possess the ability to undo death, to reverse the fundamental processes that governed the end of existence!
Noah’s gaze remained fixed upon this being as he spoke with calm directness. "What if someone collapses her existence? Can she also reverse this?"
An immense silence settled over their gathering at this question.
Royal Living Origin Thessaly’s expression grew even colder as her attention focused upon Noah.
Nobody spoke for several heartbeats, the tension building like pressure in a vessel approaching its breaking point.
Then, cutting through the oppressive quiet like a blade, booming laughter erupted from the titan-like entity who stood beside Duke Gwendolyn.
"Haha!" the being exclaimed with genuine amusement, his voice carrying a unique dialect.
"Little Brother is funny one. Very few dare talk back!"
His sentences were not entirely fluent as they seemed somewhat broken and simple.

Duke Gwendolyn’s expression remained cold as she turned to introduce this final member of their expedition. "In all of existence," she declared with absolute certainty, "no Royal or Honored Living Existence can take down Titano."
Titano!
This being, whose casual manner and easy laughter suggested someone comfortable with great violence!
Titano himself seemed entirely unconcerned with the gravity of his reputation, his attention already shifting to Noah with the focused interest of one who had found something genuinely intriguing.
He walked forward with movements that carried no threat.
"I admire you!" Titano declared with the sincerity of one who spoke only truth in any circumstance.

His gaze shifted momentarily toward Sigrid before returning to Noah with renewed intensity. "Brother, how you do it? THE Living Order is big thing, how you wrap her around you? How are you, supposed Fold Dweller, talking so freely to even Dukes as if equals? I really admire you for this, brother!"
His words missed some proper flow here and there, but his muscular figure and honest eyes were genuine!
Noah’s eyes shone with inner light as he regarded this being whose casual manner concealed depths of capability that could crush Royal Living Existences.
Internally, he smiled at the directness of questions, but outwardly he maintained the serious expression of one prepared to address them.

Duke Gwendolyn and her assembled retinue observed this exchange with expressions that mixed coldness with growing incredulity, while Sigrid smiled lightly and shook her head with the patient amusement.
"Which question do you most want an answer to?" Noah asked with the gravity of one preparing to share wisdom of Quintessence!
Titano’s gaze shifted once more toward Sigrid, his expression becoming thoughtful as he considered the relative importance of the mysteries that demanded his attention.
"Question relating to her," he decided with characteristic directness. "How you bag her down?"
Noah nodded with the seriousness of one about to deliver a lesson of fundamental importance. "Brother, are you rich or poor in regards to existence?"
The question seemed to catch Titano off guard, his expression shifting to one of genuine consideration as he processed implications that had not occurred to him.
"What defines rich and poor?" he asked after several moments of contemplation.

"Someone poor in existence," Noah explained with the patience of a teacher addressing a promising but naive student, "just has themselves and their power, nothing else. Someone rich has treasures. Things that can make Honored Ones, Royal Living Existences, and even Dukes jealous."
He paused to let these words settle before continuing. "Do you have anything like that?"

Titano’s response came without hesitation, his honesty cutting through any pretense that might have clouded the issue. "No, brother. I only have hands that can break bones of Honored and Royal Living Existences..."

Noah shook his head with the sadness of one delivering unwelcome but necessary truth. "Then you are poor, brother. And the poor in existence... will have to fight tooth and nail to get anything, especially a baddie like her."

The lesson struck Titano with the force of heavy revelation, his terrifying eyes shining with newfound understanding as he nodded with the enthusiasm of one who had just discovered principles that could reshape his entire approach to existence!
Off to the side, Duke Gwendolyn shook her head with expressions of incredulity that bordered on disbelief.
Sigrid had a calm smile while Altheon’s gaze was cloudy, but he did not say a single thing as Titano...was a terrifying weapon of the Living Origins even he had only heard about!
And now...even this being was freely talking to the Fold Dweller, Noah Osmont!

The Living Origin Authority that cascaded over her form like liquid starlight!
